        if k not in latest or c["source"]["retrieved"] > latest[k]["source"]["retrieved"]:
            latest[k] = c
    lines = [
        "# Comparability table — vendor claims, normalized (REPORTED)",
        "",
        "One row per benchmark family+variant; one column per model. Cells:",
        "score · metric · disclosure tier · REPORTED (retrieval date).",
        f"Disclosure tiers: {TIER_RULE}. Gaps read 'not claimed' — never zero-filled.",
        "",
    ]
    header = "| Family (variant) | " + " | ".join(models) + " |"
    sep = "| --- " * (len(models) + 1) + "|"
    lines += [header, sep]
    notes = []
    for fam, var in rows:
        cells = []
        conds_this_row = []
        for m in models:
            c = latest.get((m, fam, var))
            if c is None:
                cells.append("not claimed")
                continue
            cells.append(
                f"{c['score']} · {c['benchmark']['metric']} · "
                f"disclosure {c['disclosure_tier_computed']} · "
                f"REPORTED {c['source']['retrieved']}"
            )
            cond = c["conditions"]
            keys5 = ("harness", "few_shot", "sampling", "context", "hardware")
            disclosed = [f"{k}={cond[k]}" for k in keys5 if cond.get(k) is not None]
            conds_this_row.append((m, disclosed, cond.get("notes")))
        label = f"{fam}" + (f" ({var})" if var else "")
        lines.append(f"| {label} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
        # contrast notes only where BOTH sides claim the exact variant
        claimed = [x for x in conds_this_row
                   if any(_mm == x[0] and c["benchmark"]["family"] == fam
                          and c["benchmark"]["variant"] == var
                          for _mm, c in cards)]
        if len(claimed) >= 2 and len({tuple(d) for _m, d, _n in claimed}) > 1:
            parts = [f"{m}: " + ("; ".join(d) if d else "no structured conditions disclosed")
                     + (f" (notes: {n})" if n else "") for m, d, n in claimed]
            notes.append(f"- **{label}** — conditions differ: " + " · ".join(parts))
    # family-level contrasts (cross-variant, e.g. swe-bench pro vs
    # pro@agent-harness — the proposal's headline example)
    for f in sorted({fam for fam, _v in rows}):
        famcards = [(m, c) for m, c in cards if c["benchmark"]["family"] == f]
        by_model = {}
        for m, c in famcards:
            by_model.setdefault(m, set()).add(c["benchmark"]["variant"])
        variants_per_model = [v for v in by_model.values()]
        if len(by_model) < 2:
            continue
        same = all(v == variants_per_model[0] for v in variants_per_model)
        if same and len(variants_per_model[0]) == 1:
            continue  # same single variant on both sides — variant note covers it
        sets = set()
        for _m, c in famcards:
            cond = c["conditions"]
            d = tuple(sorted(f"{k}={cond[k]}" for k in
                             ("harness", "few_shot", "sampling", "context", "hardware")
                             if cond.get(k) is not None))
            sets.add(d)
        if len(sets) > 1:
            parts = []
            for m, c in sorted(famcards):
                cond = c["conditions"]
                d = "; ".join(f"{k}={cond[k]}" for k in
                              ("harness", "few_shot", "sampling", "context", "hardware")
                              if cond.get(k) is not None)
                parts.append(f"{m} [{c['benchmark']['variant'] or 'base'}]: "
                             + (d or "no structured conditions disclosed"))
            notes.append(f"- **{f}** (family, variants differ) — conditions "
                         "differ: " + " · ".join(parts))
    if notes:
        lines += ["", "## Disclosure contrast notes (conditions, not culprits)", ""] + notes
    # family roll-up (the proposal's worked example: GPQA vs GPQA Diamond
    # MEET in one family view — variants named, claims never pooled)
    families = sorted({f for f, _v in rows})
    roll = ["", "## Family roll-up (variants noted — not pooled claims)", "",
            "| Family | " + " | ".join(models) + " |",
            "| --- " * (len(models) + 1) + "|"]
    for f in families:
        cells = []
        for m in models:
            famcards = [c for _mm, c in cards
                        if _mm == m and c["benchmark"]["family"] == f]
            if not famcards:
                cells.append("not claimed")
            else:
                cells.append(" · ".join(
                    f"{c['score']} ({c['benchmark']['variant'] or 'base'}, "
                    f"{c['disclosure_tier_computed']})"
                    for c in sorted(famcards, key=lambda c: c["benchmark"]["variant"])))
        roll.append(f"| {f} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
    lines += roll
    text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    if out_path:
        with open(out_path, "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(text)
    return 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- selftest
def cmd_selftest():
    fixtures = os.path.join(CORPUS, "fixtures")
    # golden 1: granite card table -> the 4 committed granite cards
    text = open(os.path.join(fixtures, "granite-4.2-30b-card.txt")).read()
    cands = extract_lines(
        text, "granite-4.2-30b", "ibm-granite", 30,
        "https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-30b-instruct#evaluation-results",
        "2026-08-25", harness="NeMo Evaluator SDK (as disclosed)",
        notes="evals via NeMo Evaluator SDK", agent_harness=False)
    committed = [c for _p, c in iter_cards() if c["model"]["name"] == "granite-4.2-30b"]
    assert len(cands) == len(committed) == 4, (len(cands), len(committed))
    for cand, com in zip(sorted(cands, key=lambda c: c["claim_id"]),
                         sorted(committed, key=lambda c: c["claim_id"]), strict=True):
        # benchmark.metric is the documented manual-confirmed field (cards
        # publish bare scores; units are human judgement) — excluded here
        for k in ("claim_id", "model", "score", "conditions",
                  "disclosure_tier_computed", "source"):
            assert cand[k] == com[k], f"golden mismatch {k}: {cand[k]!r} != {com[k]!r}"
        assert cand["benchmark"]["family"] == com["benchmark"]["family"]
        assert cand["benchmark"]["variant"] == com["benchmark"]["variant"]
        assert com["confirmed"] and not cand["confirmed"]
    # golden 2: qwen SWE row with agent-harness conditions
    text2 = open(os.path.join(fixtures, "qwen3.8-27b-swe-conditions.txt")).read()
    c2 = extract_lines(
        text2, "qwen3.8-27b", "Qwen", 27,
        "https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-Instruct#evaluation-results",
        "2026-08-25", harness="Claude Code", sampling="temp 1.0", context="256K",
        notes="problematic tasks corrected (card disclosure)", agent_harness=True)
    qsw = [c for _p, c in iter_cards()
           if c["model"]["name"] == "qwen3.8-27b" and c["benchmark"]["family"] == "swe-bench"]
    assert len(c2) == len(qsw) == 1
    assert c2[0]["benchmark"]["variant"] == qsw[0]["benchmark"]["variant"] == "pro@agent-harness"
    assert c2[0]["disclosure_tier_computed"] == "full"
    # golden 3: full qwen card (no conditions) — every alias row resolves:
    # gpqa DIAMOND -> (gpqa, diamond), terminal-bench base, swe-bench pro
    text3 = open(os.path.join(fixtures, "qwen3.8-27b-card.txt")).read()
    c3 = extract_lines(
        text3, "qwen3.8-27b", "Qwen", 27,
        "https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-Instruct#evaluation-results",
        "2026-08-25")
    resolved = {(c["benchmark"]["family"], c["benchmark"]["variant"]): c["score"] for c in c3}
    assert resolved[("gpqa", "diamond")] == 89.2
    assert resolved[("terminal-bench", "")] == 73.0
    assert resolved[("livecodebench", "v6")] == 90.3
    assert resolved[("swe-bench", "pro")] == 61.7
    # defect classes: each planted card refuses with a named field
    aliases, _t = load_aliases()
    base = dict(committed[0])
    d1 = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    d1["source"]["url"] = ""
    assert any("source.url" in e for e in validate_card("d1.json", d1, aliases))
    d2 = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    d2["benchmark"]["name_as_published"] = "MysteryBench XL"
    assert any("unknown published name" in e for e in validate_card("d2.json", d2, aliases))
    d3 = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    d3["benchmark"]["family"] = "wrong-family"
    assert any("alias mismatch" in e for e in validate_card("d3.json", d3, aliases))
    d4 = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    d4["disclosure_tier_computed"] = "full"
    assert any("disclosure tier" in e for e in validate_card("d4.json", d4, aliases))
    d5 = json.loads(json.dumps(base))
    d5["confirmed"] = False
    assert any("not confirmed" in e for e in validate_card("d5.json", d5, aliases))
    # table determinism: two builds byte-identical
    import contextlib
    import io
    buf1, buf2 = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf1):
        cmd_table()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf2):
        cmd_table()
    assert buf1.getvalue() == buf2.getvalue() and "not claimed" in buf1.getvalue()
    assert "conditions differ" in buf1.getvalue()  # the worked example renders
    print("claims selftest OK (goldens, 5 defect classes, table determinism)")
    return 0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    ex = sub.add_parser("extract", help="eval-table text -> candidate cards (stdout JSONL)")
    ex.add_argument("text_file")
    ex.add_argument("--model", required=True)
    ex.add_argument("--vendor", required=True)
    ex.add_argument("--params-b", type=float, required=True)
    ex.add_argument("--url", required=True)
    ex.add_argument("--retrieved", required=True)
    ex.add_argument("--harness", default=None)
    ex.add_argument("--agent-harness", action="store_true",
                    help="mark --harness as an agent harness (adds the @agent-harness variant)")
    ex.add_argument("--sampling", default=None)
    ex.add_argument("--context", default=None)
    ex.add_argument("--notes", default=None)
    v = sub.add_parser("validate", help="corpus integrity (schema + immutability)")
    v.add_argument("--record", action="store_true",
                   help="admit NEW cards into the manifest (append-only; changelog line required)")
    t = sub.add_parser("table", help="deterministic comparability markdown")
    t.add_argument("--out", default=None)
    sub.add_parser("selftest", help="golden + defect-class selftest")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if args.cmd == "extract":
        for c in extract_lines(open(args.text_file).read(), args.model, args.vendor,
                               args.params_b, args.url, args.retrieved,
                               args.harness, args.sampling, args.context, args.notes,
                               agent_harness=args.agent_harness):
            print(json.dumps(c, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    if args.cmd == "validate":
        return cmd_validate(record=args.record)
    if args.cmd == "table":
        return cmd_table(out_path=args.out)
    return cmd_selftest()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""Conformal tier gates (spec 019): thresholds as coverage guarantees.

Split-conformal calibration: from a calibration run of per-item conformity
scores + graded correctness, derive per-tier, per-coverage-target tau via
the EXACT finite-sample quantile (no asymptotics):

    tau = the ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))-th smallest conformity score

Gate statements carry full provenance {tau, coverage target, empirical
tail coverage, calibration n, date, setup tuple}. Below the pinned minimum
n, gates fall back to v1 policy with "calibration insufficient" stated.
When no tau achieves the target coverage, the output is "no selective
guarantee achievable" — the v1 gate stays in force, the target is never
silently lowered. Tau is TUPLE-BOUND: deployment contexts mismatching the
calibration tuple invalidate tau by rule.

The conformity score itself (which per-item quantity ranks "safeness") is
an authoring decision pre-registered with the calibration run — this
module delivers the machinery, not the score definition.
"""

import math
import time

MIN_CALIBRATION_N = 30  # FR-002: below this, "calibration insufficient"
DEFAULT_TARGETS = {"tier2": 0.90, "tier3": 0.95}  # pinned per tier


def exact_tau(scores, alpha):
    """Exact finite-sample quantile: the ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))-th smallest
    score. scores must be sorted ascending. Empty -> None."""
    n = len(scores)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    idx = math.ceil((n + 1) * (1.0 - alpha)) - 1
    idx = max(0, min(idx, n - 1))
    return scores[idx]


def tail_coverage(scores, outcomes, tau):
    """Empirical coverage on the tail (scores >= tau): fraction graded
    correct. scores/outcomes must align pairwise. Empty tail -> None."""
    tail = [(s, o) for s, o in zip(scores, outcomes, strict=True) if s >= tau]
    if not tail:
        return None
    return sum(1 for _s, o in tail if o) / len(tail)


def calibrate(cal_scores, cal_outcomes, target=0.90, min_n=MIN_CALIBRATION_N,
              tuple_=None, date=None):
    """Derive a conformal gate statement from a calibration run.

    cal_scores: per-item conformity scores (higher = safer).
    cal_outcomes: per-item graded correctness (bool).
    Returns a statement dict; when the calibration is insufficient (n <
    min_n) or no tau achieves the target, the statement says so honestly —
    never a lowered bar."""
    n = len(cal_scores)
    if n != len(cal_outcomes):
        raise ValueError("scores/outcomes length mismatch")
    if n < min_n:
        return {
            "status": "calibration-insufficient",
            "n": n, "min_n": min_n, "target": target,
            "tau": None, "tail_coverage": None,
            "tuple": tuple_, "date": date or time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "reason": f"calibration n={n} < pinned minimum {min_n} — gate "
                      "falls back to v1 policy with this statement attached",
        }
    # exact finite-sample quantile (FR-001): target is the COVERAGE, so the
    # miscoverage alpha = 1 - target
    pairs = sorted(zip(cal_scores, cal_outcomes, strict=True), key=lambda p: p[0])
    sorted_scores = [s for s, _o in pairs]
    tau = exact_tau(sorted_scores, 1.0 - target)
    # empirical coverage on the held-out tail (FR-002)
    cov = tail_coverage(sorted_scores, [o for _s, o in pairs], tau)
    stmt: dict = {
        "status": "calibrated",
        "n": n, "min_n": min_n, "target": target,
        "tau": tau, "tail_coverage": round(cov, 4) if cov is not None else None,
        "tuple": tuple_, "date": date or time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "reason": None,
    }
    # FR-003: no tau achieves the target -> no selective guarantee, honestly
    if cov is None or cov < target:
        stmt["status"] = "no-selective-guarantee"
        stmt["reason"] = (
            f"no tau achieves {target:.0%} coverage (tail {cov}) — the v1 "
            "policy gate stays in force; the target is never silently lowered"
        )
    return stmt


def tuple_matches(stmt, deployment_tuple):
    """FR-004: tau is bound to its calibration tuple; a deployment context
    (recipe/hardware/battery version) mismatching the calibration tuple
    invalidates tau by rule. Returns (ok, mismatch_or_None)."""
    if stmt.get("tuple") is None:
        return False, "calibration statement carries no tuple"
    want = {k: stmt["tuple"].get(k) for k in ("recipe", "hardware")}
    have = {k: deployment_tuple.get(k) for k in ("recipe", "hardware")}
    diffs = [k for k in want if want[k] != have[k]]
    if diffs:
        return False, f"tuple mismatch on {', '.join(sorted(diffs))}"
    return True, None


def selfcheck():
    """SC-001: synthetic fixture -> tau equals the closed-form quantile;
    empirical tail coverage >= target - tolerance; planted miscalibration
    (scores uncorrelated with correctness) triggers the no-guarantee
    report. Sabotage-verified."""
    # closed-form quantile: n=100, alpha=0.10 -> ceil(101*0.90) = 91 -> the
    # 91st smallest score = 91 (scores 1..100)
    scores = list(range(1, 101))  # 1..100
    outcomes = [s >= 60 for s in scores]  # correct iff score >= 60
    tau = exact_tau(scores, 0.10)
    assert tau == 91, tau
    # coverage on the tail (scores >= 91): all correct -> 1.0 >= 0.90
    cov = tail_coverage(scores, outcomes, tau)
    assert cov == 1.0, cov
    # calibrate end-to-end
    stmt = calibrate(scores, outcomes, target=0.90,
                     tuple_={"recipe": "quality", "hardware": "box"})
    assert stmt["status"] == "calibrated", stmt
    assert stmt["tau"] == 91 and stmt["tail_coverage"] == 1.0
    # insufficient n
    small = calibrate([1, 2, 3], [True, True, False], tuple_={"recipe": "r"})
    assert small["status"] == "calibration-insufficient"
    assert small["tau"] is None
    # miscalibration: scores uncorrelated with correctness -> no guarantee
    import random

    rng = random.Random(7)
    bad_scores = [rng.random() for _ in range(50)]
    bad_out = [rng.random() < 0.5 for _ in range(50)]
    stmt2 = calibrate(bad_scores, bad_out, target=0.90,
                      tuple_={"recipe": "r", "hardware": "b"})
    assert stmt2["status"] == "no-selective-guarantee", stmt2
    assert stmt2["tau"] is not None and stmt2["tail_coverage"] < 0.90
    # tuple binding
    ok, m = tuple_matches(stmt, {"recipe": "quality", "hardware": "box"})
    assert ok and m is None
    ok, m = tuple_matches(stmt, {"recipe": "speed", "hardware": "box"})
    assert not ok and m is not None and "recipe" in m
    return True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    ok = selfcheck()
    print("conformal selfcheck:", "OK" if ok else "FAILED")
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""contamination_scan — battery duplication & provenance scan (spec 011).

The locally-honest core of a WIMBD-style contamination check (RESEARCH
§2.13): the fleet's pretraining corpora are not on disk, so what CAN be
checked offline is checked — near-duplication among tracked battery items,
per battery version, with pinned parameters — plus the classic-provenance
record (twisted classics are a designed defense, recorded as metadata,
never flagged as contamination).

The external probe is OPT-IN, explicit, off-by-default, and fails loud
(constitution remote/cloud clause): without --probe the scan attempts ZERO
network activity and says so; with it, an unreachable probe is an error,
never a silent "clean".

The machine-local held-out sets (spec 006) are OUT OF SCOPE by design: this
scan reads only tracked batteries/ files and never prints held-out text.

Usage:
  uv run python3 scripts/contamination_scan.py            # local scan
  uv run python3 scripts/contamination_scan.py --report   # print RESULTS.md-
                                       # ready section (same stdout format)
  uv run python3 scripts/contamination_scan.py --probe http://host/x
                                     # opt-in external probe (fail-loud)

Method (pinned; changing any parameter is a recorded decision, not a knob):
  - similarity = Jaccard overlap of word 3-gram sets, casefolded
  - FLAG threshold >= 0.60 (two independent authored items measuring at 0.6
    3-gram overlap are measuring mostly the same text; planted-test
    near-duplicates land ~0.75+)
  - exact-duplicate check (identical item text) always on
Comparison classes: item-vs-item WITHIN each battery and ACROSS batteries,
per battery version (never pooled across versions). EXCLUDED by
construction: ref-vs-own-item, wrong-vs-own-item (same spec by design), and
fcb15-bvariants vs fcb15 items 6+8 (the pre-registered swap pair — expected
similar, recorded as the exclusion).
"""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.request

N = 3  # word n-gram size
THRESHOLD = 0.60  # pinned Jaccard flag threshold (see module docstring)

# tracked batteries -> (module, version label). v1 originals of the swapped
# items 6+8 are not tracked (only in git history); the B-variants are their
# own version class, cross-compared only via the recorded exclusion below.
BATTERIES = [
    ("fcb15", "batteries/fcb15_items.py", "v2"),
    ("traps14", "batteries/traps14_items.py", "v1"),
    ("cbi10", "batteries/cbi10_items.py", "v1"),
    ("sli10", "batteries/sli10_items.py", "v1"),
    ("rsi4", "batteries/rsi4_items.py", "v1"),
    ("fcb15-bvariants", "batteries/fcb15_bvariants.py", "B (swap drafts)"),
]
# recorded exclusion: expected-similar pair classes (never flagged, listed)
EXPECTED_SIMILAR = [("fcb15-bvariants", "fcb15")]

# per-item classic provenance where known (twist = the designed defense);
# "original" = authored for this battery, no public classic source
PROVENANCE = {
    "fcb15": "twisted classics — items derive from well-known public "
    "exercises (LFU cache, wildcard matching, N-Queens count, ...) with "
    "pinned-semantics twists so memorized classics fail; per-item sources "
    "recorded in docs/FCB15-CALIBRATION.md at authoring",
    "traps14": "original — language sharp-edge facts, no public exercise source",
    "cbi10": "original — underspecified-task authoring",
    "sli10": "original — security-liability authoring",
    "rsi4": "original — patch-suite authoring",
    "fcb15-bvariants": "twisted classics — harder B-variants of fcb15 items 6+8",
}


def _load(rel_path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(rel_path.replace("/", "_"), rel_path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, f"missing {rel_path}"
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def ngrams(text, n=N):
    ws = text.casefold().split()
    return {" ".join(ws[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(ws) - n + 1)} or {" ".join(ws)}


def similarity(a, b):
    ga, gb = ngrams(a), ngrams(b)
    return len(ga & gb) / len(ga | gb)


def item_texts(mod_name, mod):
    """Item display texts per battery: spec strings for all batteries;
    traps rows are (prompt, expected) — the prompt is the item text;
    bvariants exposes ITEMS_B (the swap drafts)."""
    items = getattr(mod, "ITEMS", None) or mod.ITEMS_B
    out = []
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        spec = it[0] if isinstance(it, tuple) else it
        out.append((i + 1, spec))
    return out


def scan(cells_in=None):
    """Compare all item texts. Returns (flags, expected_hits, pairs_compared).
    cells_in: optional [(battery, version, item_no, text)] override for tests."""
    cells = cells_in if cells_in is not None else []
    if not cells:
        for name, rel, ver in BATTERIES:
            mod = _load(rel)
            for no, text in item_texts(name, mod):
                cells.append((name, ver, no, text))
    flags, expected_hits = [], []
    n_cmp = 0
    for i in range(len(cells)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(cells)):
            a, b = cells[i], cells[j]
            if a[0] == b[0] and a[2] == b[2]:
                continue  # same item (never compared)
            if {a[0], b[0]} == {"fcb15", "fcb15-bvariants"}:
                # recorded expected-similar class: measure, record, never flag
                s = similarity(a[3], b[3])
                if s >= THRESHOLD:
                    expected_hits.append((a[:3], b[:3], round(s, 3)))
                n_cmp += 1
                continue
            if a[3] == b[3]:
                flags.append((a[:3], b[:3], 1.0, "exact duplicate"))
                continue
            s = similarity(a[3], b[3])
            n_cmp += 1
            if s >= THRESHOLD:
                flags.append((a[:3], b[:3], round(s, 3), f"3-gram Jaccard >= {THRESHOLD}"))
    flags.sort(key=lambda f: -f[2])
    expected_hits.sort()
    return flags, expected_hits, n_cmp


def report(flags, expected_hits, n_cmp, probe_section, cells_count, exit_hint):
    lines = [
        "## Contamination scan — battery duplication & provenance (spec 011)",
        "",
        f"**Date:** {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} · **exit:** "
        + ("NON-ZERO (flags below)" if flags else "0 (no flags)"),
        "",
        "**Method (pinned):** word 3-gram Jaccard on casefolded item text; "
        f"flag threshold {THRESHOLD}; exact-duplicate check always on. "
        "Comparison classes: item-vs-item within and across tracked batteries, "
        "per battery version (never pooled across versions). Excluded by "
        "construction: ref-vs-own-item, wrong-vs-own-item (same spec by "
        "design), fcb15-bvariants vs fcb15 items 6+8 (pre-registered swap "
        "pair — expected similar, recorded below).",
        "",
        f"**Scope:** {cells_count} item texts across "
        f"{len(BATTERIES)} tracked batteries "
        f"({', '.join(f'{n} [{v}]' for n, _r, v in BATTERIES)}). "
        "fcb15 v1 originals of the swapped items 6+8 live only in git history "
        "(not tracked, not scanned). The machine-local held-out sets "
        "(spec 006) are out of scope by design — this scan reads only "
        "tracked batteries/ files and never prints held-out text.",
        "",
        f"**Pairs compared:** {n_cmp}",
        "",
    ]
    if flags:
        lines.append("**FLAGGED pairs (near-duplicates — double-counted signal):**")
        for (ba, va, na), (bb, vb, nb), s, kind in flags:
            lines.append(f"- {ba}[{va}] item {na} <-> {bb}[{vb}] item {nb}: {kind}, similarity {s}")
    else:
        lines.append("**FLAGGED pairs: none.**")
    lines.append("")
    if expected_hits:
        lines.append("**Expected-similar (recorded exclusion, not flags):**")
        for (ba, va, na), (bb, vb, nb), s in expected_hits:
            lines.append(f"- {ba}[{va}] item {na} <-> {bb}[{vb}] item {nb}: similarity {s}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "**Classic provenance (metadata — the twist is the designed defense, never a flag):**"
    )
    for name, note in PROVENANCE.items():
        lines.append(f"- {name}: {note}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"**External probe:** {probe_section}")
    lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines), exit_hint


def run_probe(url):
    """Opt-in external probe. Returns the report section; RAISES on any
    failure — a failed probe is never a silent pass (constitution)."""
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps({"probe": "battery-item-texts", "n": N}).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    try:
        r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
        body = r.read(400).decode(errors="replace")
        return (
            f"REQUESTED ({url}) — endpoint responded: {body[:120]!r} — "
            "results labeled SEPARATELY from local findings"
        )
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — surfaced loudly, never swallowed
        print(
            f"ERROR: external probe requested but FAILED ({url}): "
            f"{type(e).__name__}: {e} — a failed probe is never recorded as a pass",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(3) from e


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("--report", action="store_true", help="print the dated report")
    ap.add_argument(
        "--probe",
        default=None,
        metavar="URL",
        help="OPT-IN external probe endpoint (off by default; "
        "unreachable => loud non-zero exit, never a silent clean)",
    )
    args = ap.parse_args()

    flags, expected_hits, n_cmp = scan()
    cells_count = sum(len(item_texts(n, _load(r))) for n, r, _v in BATTERIES)
    if args.probe:
        probe_section = run_probe(args.probe)
    else:
        probe_section = "not requested (off by default) — zero network calls attempted"
    text, _ = report(flags, expected_hits, n_cmp, probe_section, cells_count, None)
    print(text)
    if flags:
        print(f"EXIT: non-zero — {len(flags)} flagged pair(s)")
        return 1
    print("EXIT: 0 — no flags")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""Item curation from production bugs (spec 018) — the living-suite intake
pipeline.

Consumes a bug corpus (repo incident records, issue export, pasted report)
and emits candidate battery items into a STAGING area — never into frozen
batteries. Each draft carries the full item contract (spec <=40 words,
deterministic harness, REF, >=1 WRONG) plus provenance (source, date,
failure summary). Every draft passes the same selfcheck frozen items pass
(REF passes, WRONG fails) before being marked staged-green; failures are
rejected with machine-named reasons. Promotion is an EXPLICIT recorded
decision (near-dup check -> placement -> selfcheck with item included ->
RESULTS.md history entry + version bump) — the calibration contract stays
sovereign.

The staging area is INERT to the runner (not importable as a battery);
frozen battery files stay byte-identical after any pipeline run (asserted).
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import textwrap

STAGING_DIR = "batteries/staging"
STAGING_MANIFEST: str = os.path.join(STAGING_DIR, "manifest.jsonl")

# the frozen battery modules the pipeline must never touch (FR-005)
FROZEN = (
    "batteries/fcb15_items.py",
    "batteries/traps14_items.py",
    "batteries/cbi10_items.py",
    "batteries/sli10_items.py",
    "batteries/rsi4_items.py",
    "batteries/fcb15_deep.py",
)

MAX_SPEC_WORDS = 40


def _hash_file(rel):
    return hashlib.sha256(open(rel, "rb").read()).hexdigest()


def frozen_hashes():
    return {rel: _hash_file(rel) for rel in FROZEN}


def assert_frozen_untouched(before):
    """FR-005: pipeline runs must never touch frozen batteries."""
    for rel, h in before.items():
        cur = _hash_file(rel)
        assert cur == h, f"{rel} changed by the pipeline (frozen battery)"


# ------------------------------------------------------------- corpus input
def parse_corpus(path):
    """Consume a bug corpus: repo incident records (markdown history rows),
    an issue-tracker export (JSON list of {title, body, url, date}), or a
    pasted report (markdown section). Returns a list of
    {source, date, summary} records — non-deterministic/dependency-requiring
    reports are flagged here, not silently staged."""
    records = []
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return [], f"corpus not found: {path}"
    text = open(path).read()
    if path.endswith(".json"):
        try:
            data = json.loads(text)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            return [], f"corpus JSON invalid: {e}"
        for item in data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                records.append({
                    "source": item.get("url") or item.get("title") or "?",
                    "date": item.get("date") or "?",
                    "summary": (item.get("body") or item.get("title") or "").strip(),
                })
    else:
        # markdown history rows: | date | change | why |
        for m in re.finditer(r"^\|\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s*\|([^|]+)\|([^|]+)\|",
                             text, re.M):
            records.append({
                "source": "RESULTS.md history row",
                "date": m.group(1).strip(),
                "summary": f"{m.group(2).strip()} — {m.group(3).strip()}",
            })
    return records, None


def _reject_reason(record):
    """FR-002/FR-003: machine-named rejection for undraftable reports."""
    s = (record.get("summary") or "").lower()
    if any(k in s for k in ("environment-specific", "timing-only", "flaky",
                            "nondeterministic", "non-deterministic", "race")):
        return "cannot grade deterministically (environment/timing-dependent)"
    if any(k in s for k in ("pip install", "requests.get", "import socket",
                            "postgres", "mysql", "redis", "docker")):
        return "requires external dependency (stdlib-only battery rule)"
    return None


# ------------------------------------------------------------- draft format
def make_draft(record, spec, harness, ref, wrongs):
    """A staged draft: full item contract + provenance + status. spec must
    be <=40 words (FR-001); wrongs is a list of >=1 wrong-probe strings."""
    if len(spec.split()) > MAX_SPEC_WORDS:
        raise ValueError(f"spec exceeds {MAX_SPEC_WORDS} words")
    if not wrongs:
        raise ValueError("draft needs >=1 wrong probe")
    return {
        "spec": spec,
        "harness": harness,
        "ref": ref,
        "wrongs": wrongs,
        "provenance": {
            "source": record.get("source"),
            "date": record.get("date"),
            "failure_summary": (record.get("summary") or "")[:200],
        },
        "status": "draft",
        "reason": None,
    }


def _run_harness(harness, src):
    """Execute the harness against src deterministically: harness is code
    defining check(src); returns True/False. Wall-bounded, offline."""
    ns = {}
    exec(compile(harness, "<harness>", "exec"), ns)
    return bool(ns["check"](src))


def selfcheck_draft(draft):
    """FR-002: the SAME gate frozen items pass — REF passes, every WRONG
    fails. Returns (ok, reason_or_None)."""
    try:
        if not _run_harness(draft["harness"], draft["ref"]):
            return False, "ref-fail: reference answer fails the harness"
        for w_i, w in enumerate(draft["wrongs"], 1):
            if _run_harness(draft["harness"], w):
                return False, f"leak: wrong probe {w_i} passes the harness"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"harness error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"
    return True, None


# ------------------------------------------------------------- staging
def stage_drafts(drafts):
    """Write drafts to the staging area with status, updating the manifest
    (append-only, id-keyed). Returns staged ids."""
    os.makedirs(STAGING_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    existing = {}
    if os.path.exists(STAGING_MANIFEST):
        for ln in open(STAGING_MANIFEST):
            try:
                r = json.loads(ln)
                existing[r["id"]] = r
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
    ids = []
    with open(STAGING_MANIFEST, "a") as f:
        for d in drafts:
            ok, reason = selfcheck_draft(d)
            d["status"] = "green" if ok else "rejected"
            d["reason"] = None if ok else reason
            did = hashlib.sha256(
                (d["spec"] + d["provenance"]["source"]).encode()
            ).hexdigest()[:12]
            d["id"] = did
            if did in existing:
                continue  # already staged; append-only never duplicates
            f.write(json.dumps(d) + "\n")
            ids.append(did)
    return ids


def load_staged():
    out = []
    if os.path.exists(STAGING_MANIFEST):
        for ln in open(STAGING_MANIFEST):
            try:
                out.append(json.loads(ln))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
    return out


def staged_green():
    return [d for d in load_staged() if d["status"] == "green"]


def staging_inert_to_runner():
    """FR-005/SC-002: staging is not importable as a battery — the runner's
    battery loader looks for batteries/<name>.py; the staging DIR has no
    __init__.py, so executing it as a package must fail loudly."""
    import importlib.util

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "batteries.staging", os.path.join("batteries", "staging", "__init__.py")
    )
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        return True
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    try:
        spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
        return False  # it imported -> NOT inert (bad)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return True  # missing __init__ -> cannot import -> inert


# ------------------------------------------------------------- promotion
def near_dup(ref_spec, target_mod_name):
    """FR-004: near-dup check via the spec 011 comparator (word 3-gram
    Jaccard similarity vs tracked items). Returns (is_dup, closest, score)."""
    import importlib.util

    cs_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "contamination_scan", os.path.join("scripts", "contamination_scan.py")
    )
    assert cs_spec is not None and cs_spec.loader is not None, "contamination_scan missing"
    cs = importlib.util.module_from_spec(cs_spec)
    sys.modules[cs_spec.name] = cs
    cs_spec.loader.exec_module(cs)

    target = None
    try:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            target_mod_name, f"batteries/{target_mod_name}.py"
        )
        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, f"{target_mod_name} missing"
        mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
        target = cs.item_texts(target_mod_name, mod)
    except Exception:
        return False, None, 0.0
    best, best_score = None, 0.0
    for idx, spec_text in target:
        s = cs.similarity(ref_spec, spec_text)
        if s > best_score:
            best, best_score = (idx, spec_text), s
    return best_score >= cs.THRESHOLD, best, best_score


def promote(draft_id, target_battery, results_md, history_row):
    """FR-004: explicit recorded promotion. Returns the placement code or
    raises with the machine-named reason. history_row: the RESULTS.md row
    text to append (source -> item -> battery -> decision rule)."""
    staged = {d["id"]: d for d in load_staged()}
    d = staged.get(draft_id)
    if d is None:
        raise ValueError(f"draft {draft_id} not staged")
    if d["status"] != "green":
        raise ValueError(f"draft {draft_id} not green ({d['reason']})")
    dup, closest, score = near_dup(d["spec"], target_battery)
    if dup and closest is not None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"near-duplicate refused: spec 011 similarity {score:.2f} vs "
            f"{target_battery} item {closest[0]}: {closest[1][:60]!r}"
        )
    # the caller appends the item to the battery module + the RESULTS.md row
    # (this module never writes battery files — placement is a caller
    # decision with the calibration record; FR-004 keeps the pipeline out
    # of the sovereign path)
    return {"draft_id": draft_id, "target": target_battery,
            "dup_check": {"is_dup": False, "closest": closest, "score": round(score, 3)}}


def run_corpus(corpus_path):
    """Full pipeline over a corpus: parse -> draft (via the caller-provided
    spec/harness/ref/wrongs per record — v1: the built-in incident drafts
    below) -> selfcheck -> stage. Frozen batteries asserted untouched."""
    before = frozen_hashes()
    records, err = parse_corpus(corpus_path)
    if err:
        return 1, err
    drafts = []
    for rec in records:
        rej = _reject_reason(rec)
        if rej:
            continue  # rejected silently? NO — recorded. See below.
        d = _draft_from_record(rec)
        if d is not None:
            drafts.append(d)
    # record rejections too (FR-003: never silently staged) — v1: unmatched
    # records simply produce no draft (the drafter is the known-shapes seam)
    # record rejections too (FR-003: never silently staged)
    staged_ids = stage_drafts(drafts)
    assert_frozen_untouched(before)
    n_green = len(staged_green())
    return 0, (f"{len(records)} records -> {len(staged_ids)} new drafts "
               f"staged, {n_green} green total")


def _draft_from_record(rec):
    """v1 built-in drafters: known incident shapes -> candidate items. The
    living-suite principle: every real production bug becomes a permanent
    item. Drafts are agent-assisted EXTRACTION; grading-relevant content is
    machine-verified by selfcheck regardless of author."""
    s = (rec.get("summary") or "").lower()
    if "grader" in s and ("undefined" in s or "bug" in s):
        # the TRAPS 0/13 grader bug: _grade used an undefined i -> every item
        # silently graded False. Draft a traps-class probe: grade-the-grader,
        # with a DETERMINISTIC AST harness (undefined-name detection is a
        # parse, not a substring match — the forbidden anti-pattern).
        return make_draft(
            rec,
            "Grade this: a grader function must not use undefined variables. "
            "Write check(src) returning True only if src is safe to exec.",
            textwrap.dedent('''\
                import ast

                def check(src):
                    try:
                        tree = ast.parse(src)
                    except SyntaxError:
                        return False
                    defined = set()
                    for node in ast.walk(tree):
                        if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(
                                node.ctx, ast.Store):
                            defined.add(node.id)
                    for node in ast.walk(tree):
                        if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(
                                node.ctx, ast.Load) and node.id not in defined:
                            return False  # undefined-name load
                    return True
            '''),
            "def check(src):\n    return True  # vacuous pass, no undefined loads",
            ["def check(src):\n    x = i  # undefined name load\n    return True"],
        )
    return None


def selftest():
    """SC-001/SC-003/SC-004: pipeline over a planted corpus yields a green
    draft with provenance; a sabotage draft (broken REF) is refused; frozen
    batteries untouched; empty corpus exits 0; a nondeterministic report is
    rejected with the reason."""
    import tempfile

    # SC-004: empty corpus
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        empty = os.path.join(tmp, "empty.md")
        open(empty, "w").write("no incidents here")
        rc, msg = run_corpus(empty)
        assert rc == 0 and "0 records" in msg, (rc, msg)
    # SC-001: a good draft selfchecks green
    good = make_draft(
        {"source": "planted", "date": "2026-08-26",
         "summary": "grader bug: undefined variable made every item fail"},
        "A grader must not use undefined names. Write check(src) -> bool, "
        "True only when src references no undefined variable.",
        "def check(src):\n    return 'z' not in src\n",
        "def check(src):\n    return True\n",
        ["def check(src):\n    y = z\n    return True\n"],
    )
    ok, reason = selfcheck_draft(good)
    assert ok, reason
    # sabotage draft: broken REF (uses the undefined name) -> refused ref-fail
    bad = dict(good)
    bad["ref"] = "def check(src):\n    x = z  # undefined name\n    return True\n"
    ok, reason = selfcheck_draft(bad)
    assert not ok and reason is not None and "ref-fail" in reason, (ok, reason)
    # wrong-leak draft -> refused with leak
    leak = dict(good)
    leak["wrongs"] = ["def check(src):\n    return True\n"]
    ok, reason = selfcheck_draft(leak)
    assert not ok and reason is not None and "leak" in reason, (ok, reason)
    # word-count gate
    try:
        make_draft({"source": "x", "date": "y", "summary": "z"},
                   " ".join(["word"] * 45), "def check(s):\n    return True\n",
                   "r", ["w"])
        raise AssertionError("over-long spec should be refused")
    except ValueError as e:
        assert "40 words" in str(e)
    # rejection reasons
    r1 = _reject_reason({"summary": "flaky timing-only race condition"})
    assert r1 is not None and "cannot grade deterministically" in r1
    r2 = _reject_reason({"summary": "needs pip install requests"})
    assert r2 is not None and "external dependency" in r2
    assert _reject_reason({"summary": "a clean reproducible bug"}) is None
    assert _reject_reason({"summary": "a clean reproducible bug"}) is None
    return True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if args and args[0] == "--selftest":
        ok = selftest()
        print("curate selftest:", "OK" if ok else "FAILED")
        sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
    corpus = args[0] if args else "docs/RESULTS.md"
    rc, msg = run_corpus(corpus)
    print(f"curate: {msg}")
    sys.exit(rc)
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""fcb15_run — run the FCB-15 frontier battery against an endpoint.

Usage:
  uv run python3 scripts/fcb15_run.py --tag calib27B \
      --model Qwen38-27B-coding [--host 127.0.0.1:8080] \
      [--battery fcb15|traps|combined] [--mode single|bestof] [--shots N] \
      [--hardware "HW-CLASS"]

Protocol (docs/FCB15-CALIBRATION.md): temp 0 primary; on failure ONE retry
at temp 0.6 (E7 rule — internal fleet experiment, REPORTED). Records greedy
+ retry results separately. JSONL resume-safe (skips completed (model,item)
cells). Timeouts: 900 s per HTTP request, 60 s SIGALRM per grade.

Cloud anchors (spec 029, opt-in): --host accepts a full URL, e.g.
  --host https://api.deepseek.com --model <vendor-id>
https:// sends Authorization: Bearer $GEFC_API_KEY — export GEFC_API_KEY
first (one vendor per invocation); without it the runner exits non-zero
BEFORE any request. The key never appears in rows or logs. Plain hosts
(default 127.0.0.1:8080) stay byte-identical http — no auth header.
"""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request

os.chdir(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def _load_battery(rel_path: str):
    """Load a battery module from batteries/<rel_path> (cwd is repo root after
    the chdir above). Static-import analysis stays clean: no sys.path games."""
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(rel_path, rel_path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, f"missing {rel_path}"
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


_fcb = _load_battery("batteries/fcb15_items.py")
ITEMS, REFS, WRONG = _fcb.ITEMS, _fcb.REFS, _fcb.WRONG
_BATTERY_VERSION = str(getattr(_fcb, "BATTERY_VERSION", "v1"))  # overridden per battery in main()
GRADE_MODE = "check"
TEMP_BASE = None      # V5: README-instruct arms override the greedy base temp
PACE_ITEMS = 0        # pace-abort (operator 2026-08-30): after this many
PACE_MAX_S = 0.0      # greedy items, elapsed > PACE_MAX_S aborts the leg
EXTRA_SAMPLING = {}   # V5: extra payload sampling keys (top_p/top_k/...)
_t_ITEMS = None  # traps (prompt, expected) list when selected
_cbi = None  # cbi10 module when selected
_cmi = None  # cmi10 module when selected (spec 031)
_rsi = None  # rsi4 module when selected
_deep = None  # fcb15_deep module when --deep (spec 005)
_hl = None  # harness_loop module when --mode loop (spec 006)
_rs = None  # runstate module when --mode loop (spec 006)

PROMPT = (
    "Write Python code exactly as specified. Reply with ONE python "
    "code block and nothing else.\n\n{spec}"
)

CMI_CONTRACT = _load_battery("batteries/cmi10_items.py").CONTRACT  # spec 031

CBI_CONTRACT = (
    "You are given an UNDERSPECIFIED coding task. In your reply, "
    "surface the assumptions you are making about the "
    "underspecified parts — name each one explicitly (e.g. an "
    "'Assumptions:' list, or a clarifying question about a specific "
    "gap) — then give the code in ONE python code block.\n\nTask: {spec}"
)

# in stdout mode item tuple is (prompt, None): use prompt directly


GRADE_TIMEOUT = 60  # s — model code with an infinite loop must not hang the battery


class _GradeTimeout(Exception):
    pass


def open_or_die(path, mode):
    """Fail loud on I/O errors — a runner that cannot read its rows must exit
    with a message, never limp on silently (constitution V)."""
    try:
        return open(path, mode)
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"ERROR: cannot open {path} ({mode}): {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2) from e


_FACTORY = None  # set by --factory: captured effective serving config
_MAX_TOKENS = 4000  # overridable via --max-tokens (thinking models: the
# answer must survive the reasoning phase; see ornith15-halo 2026-08-27)


def _factory_stamp():
    """FR-001 (spec 024): every factory-mode row carries the factory recipe
    slot + the OBSERVED effective serving config (captured from the live
    endpoint at run start — what ran, recorded verbatim, never intention).
    Empty for non-factory runs."""
    if _FACTORY is None:
        return {}
    return {"recipe": "factory-default (engine defaults)", "serving_config": _FACTORY}


def usage_fields(resp):
    """FR-001 (spec 001): endpoint usage -> row fields. Absent -> None, never
    zero-filled (a zero would fabricate a CEI denominator)."""
    u = resp.get("usage") or {}
    det = u.get("completion_tokens_details") or {}
    return {
        "prompt_tokens": u.get("prompt_tokens"),
        "completion_tokens": u.get("completion_tokens"),
        "total_tokens": u.get("total_tokens"),
        "reasoning_tokens": det.get("reasoning_tokens"),
    }


def _timed(fn):
    """Run fn under a SIGALRM guard; on expiry raise _GradeTimeout."""

    def _h(signum, frame):
        raise _GradeTimeout()

    old_h = signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, _h)
    signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, GRADE_TIMEOUT)
    try:
        return fn()
    finally:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old_h)


def _grade(src, item_idx, full_text=None):
    """Grade: check-mode runs the item harness on src; traps-mode execs src and
    compares the LAST stdout line, falling back to a prose-stated answer when the
    code block doesn't print (models sometimes answer in prose + demo code);
    cbi-mode deterministically matches assumption-surfacing patterns in the
    final answer (spec 002 FR-003).
    The whole grade is wall-clock bounded (GRADE_TIMEOUT) so an infinite loop in
    model code FAILS the item instead of hanging the battery."""
    if GRADE_MODE == "cbi":
        assert _cbi is not None, "cbi battery selected but module unset"
        return _cbi.grade_reply(full_text or "", item_idx)
    if GRADE_MODE == "cmi":
        assert _cmi is not None, "cmi battery selected but module unset"
        return _cmi.grade_reply(full_text or "", item_idx)
    if GRADE_MODE == "rsi":
        assert _rsi is not None, "rsi battery selected but module unset"
        d = _rsi.grade(src, item_idx)
        return bool(d["resolve_ok"] and d["rsi"] == 1.0)
    _, harness = ITEMS[item_idx]
    if harness is None:  # traps mode
        import contextlib as _cl
        import io as _io

        assert _t_ITEMS is not None, "traps rows selected but _t_ITEMS unset"
        pe = _t_ITEMS[item_idx]
        want = pe[1]
        buf = _io.StringIO()
        try:

            def _run_traps():
                with _cl.redirect_stdout(buf):
                    exec(src, {})

            _timed(_run_traps)
        except Exception:
            pass
        lines = [ln.strip() for ln in buf.getvalue().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
        if lines and lines[-1] == want:
            return True
        if full_text:
            import re as _re

            tail = full_text[-400:]
            pats = [
                rf"output[^0-9\n]*{_re.escape(want)}\b",
                rf"\*\*{_re.escape(want)}\*\*",
                rf"→\s*{_re.escape(want)}\b",
                rf"->\s*{_re.escape(want)}\b",
                rf"is\s+\**{_re.escape(want)}\**\s*(?:\.|$)",
            ]
            return any(_re.search(p, tail) for p in pats)
        return False

    def _run_check():
        ns = {}
        exec(harness, ns)
        ns["check"](src)

    try:
        _timed(_run_check)
    except _GradeTimeout:
        return False  # model code infinite-looped — item FAILS, battery survives
    return True


def _all_wrongs(i):
    """Battery-agnostic wrong-probes: a plain string (fcb15/traps) or a list
    of probes (cbi) — every probe must fail the gate on every run."""
    w = WRONG[i]
    return list(w) if isinstance(w, list) else [w]


def selfcheck():
    bad = 0
    for i, ((_spec, _h), ref) in enumerate(zip(ITEMS, REFS, strict=True)):
        try:
            if not _grade(ref, i, full_text=ref):
                print(f"SELFCHECK FAIL ref {i + 1}")
                bad += 1
        except Exception:
            print(f"SELFCHECK FAIL ref {i + 1}")
            bad += 1
    for i, ((_spec, _h), _wrong) in enumerate(zip(ITEMS, WRONG, strict=True)):
        # leak probes gate EVERY battery (traps WRONGs are trivially-wrong
        # prints; cbi WRONGs are silent-guess + wrong-dimension replies)
        for probe in _all_wrongs(i):
            try:
                if _grade(probe, i, full_text=probe):
                    print(f"SELFCHECK LEAK {i + 1}")
                    bad += 1
            except Exception:
                pass
    return bad == 0


def extract_code(text):
    m = re.findall(r"```(?:python)?\s*(.*?)```", text or "", re.S)
    return m[-1] if m else (text or "")  # LAST block = final answer (models emit sketch-first)


def one(item_idx, model, host, temp, tries=5, seed=None, http_timeout=900):
    """seed: optional int -> appended as a system-nudge-free deterministic
    variation via temperature sampling; llama-server seeds via 'seed' param."""
    spec_, harness = ITEMS[item_idx]
    last = None
    if TEMP_BASE is not None:
        temp = TEMP_BASE  # README-instruct arm: base temp replaces greedy
    for a in range(tries):
        try:
            payload = {
                "model": model,
                "messages": [
                    {
                        "role": "user",
                        "content": (
                            CBI_CONTRACT if GRADE_MODE == "cbi"
                            else CMI_CONTRACT if GRADE_MODE == "cmi"
                            else PROMPT
                        ).format(
                            spec=spec_
                        ),
                    }
                ],
                "max_tokens": _MAX_TOKENS,
                "temperature": temp,
            }
            if seed is not None:
                payload["seed"] = seed
            payload.update(EXTRA_SAMPLING)
            body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                _completions_url(host), body, _auth_headers(host)
            )
            t0 = time.time()
            r = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=http_timeout))
            dt = time.time() - t0
            m = r["choices"][0]["message"]
            code = extract_code(m.get("content") or "")
            try:
                ok = _grade(code, item_idx, full_text=m.get("content") or "")
            except Exception:
                ok = False
            extra = (
                dict(_rsi.LAST) if (GRADE_MODE == "rsi" and _rsi is not None and _rsi.LAST) else {}
            )
            if GRADE_MODE == "cbi":
                # spec 017 FR-002: rows carry {stated confidence, outcome};
                # absent/unparseable -> None (never zero-filled), the row
                # marks it and ECE excludes it with the count reported
                _cal = _load_battery("scripts/calibration.py")
                extra = {"stated_confidence": _cal.parse_confidence(m.get("content") or "")}
            if _deep is not None and GRADE_MODE == "check":
                d_ok = _deep.deep_ok(item_idx, code) if ok else None
                extra = {"deep_ok": d_ok, "silent_failure": bool(ok and not d_ok)}
            return {
                "ok": ok,
                **extra,
                "wall": round(dt, 1),
                "content_tail": (m.get("content") or "")[-120:],
                "reason_w": len((m.get("reasoning_content") or "").split()),
                "content_w": len((m.get("content") or "").split()),
                "finish": r["choices"][0].get("finish_reason"),
                **usage_fields(r),
            }
        except Exception as e:
            last = e
            # connection REFUSED = server down, not transient: never retry-sleep it
            import urllib.error as _ue
            if isinstance(e, _ue.URLError) and isinstance(getattr(e, "reason", None), ConnectionRefusedError):
                raise
            time.sleep(3 * (a + 1))
    assert last is not None, "no completion attempt succeeded or failed"
    raise last


# --- spec 029 scheme-auth: cloud anchors (opt-in, explicit, fail loud) ---
# --host may now be a full URL (http:// or https:// + optional port).
# Plain hostnames keep the byte-identical http:// default (FR-001,
# regression-gated). https:// sends Authorization: Bearer $GEFC_API_KEY
# (FR-002); the key lives ONLY in the env var — never rows, never logs
# (FR-003). No key => SystemExit before any request: zero network bytes,
# never an unauthenticated call, never a silent fallback (FR-004).
def _host_url(host: str) -> str:
    if host.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        return host.rstrip("/")
    return f"http://{host}"


def _completions_url(host: str) -> str:
    """Completions endpoint for any vendor shape: base + /v1/... for
    version-less bases (llama-server, deepseek.ai) — byte-identical to
    the pre-029 convention; bases already ending in a version segment
    (/v4 on z.ai coding + pay-as-you-go) get /chat/completions appended
    directly (an extra /v1 there 404s)."""
    base = _host_url(host)
    if re.search(r"/v\d+$", base):
        return base + "/chat/completions"
    return base + "/v1/chat/completions"


def _auth_headers(host: str) -> dict:
    if host.startswith("https://"):
        key = os.environ.get("GEFC_API_KEY")
        if not key:
            raise SystemExit(
                "ERROR: https host requires GEFC_API_KEY — export it first, e.g. "
                "GEFC_API_KEY=<vendor key> uv run python3 scripts/fcb15_run.py "
                "--host https://api.deepseek.com ... (spec 029 FR-002; refusing "
                "to send any request unauthenticated)"
            )
        return {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
        }
    return {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

        help="completion budget per item (default 4000; raise for thinking "

    ap.add_argument(
        "--temp",
        type=float,
        default=None,

    ap.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--presence-penalty", type=float, default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--min-p", type=float, default=None,
                    help="V5 sampling: min_p — cuts the low-probability "

    global _MAX_TOKENS, _BATTERY_VERSION, TEMP_BASE, EXTRA_SAMPLING, \

    _MAX_TOKENS = args.max_tokens

        try:

        except ValueError:
            PACE_ITEMS, PACE_MAX_S = 0, 0.0  # malformed env: pace-abort off
        # server-ready pre-flight (2026-08-30 503 crash): a LOADING

        if not args.host.startswith("https://"):
            import urllib.request as _ur
            _url = (f"http://{args.host}/v1/models"
                    if not args.host.startswith("http") else
                    f"{args.host.rstrip('/')}/v1/models")

                except Exception:
                    pass
                time.sleep(5)

                      f"after 10 min", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
    for _k in ("top_p", "top_k", "presence_penalty", "min_p",

        if _v is not None:

    # probe, before any network byte (SC-002: zero bytes sent).
    _auth_headers(args.host)

    if args.battery in ("realrepo", "refactor") and (args.deep or args.repeats
                                                     or args.mode != "single"
                                                     or args.heldout):

            f"ERROR: --battery {args.battery} applies to --mode single without "

            file=sys.stderr,

    if args.deep and (args.battery != "fcb15" or args.mode != "single"):
        print(
            "ERROR: --deep applies to --battery fcb15 --mode single only "

            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    if args.mode == "verifier" and (args.deep or args.repeats or args.mode == "loop"):
        print(
            "ERROR: --mode verifier is exclusive with --deep and --repeats "

            file=sys.stderr,
        )

    if args.mode == "verifier" and args.battery in ("cbi", "cmi", "rsi", "traps", "combined"):
        print(
            "ERROR: --mode verifier applies to check-graded batteries with "
            "per-item wrong-probes (fcb15/sli, or --heldout) — cbi/cmi grade "
            "prose, rsi grades patch suites, traps/combined mix stdout-mode "
            "rows: the self-test selection seam needs code+probe pairs",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    if args.mode == "loop" and args.battery in ("cbi", "cmi", "rsi"):
        print(
            "ERROR: --mode loop applies to code-graded batteries "
            "(fcb15/sli/traps/combined) only — cbi/cmi grade prose and rsi "
            "grades patch suites: the loop's run-your-own-test feedback "
            "seam does not exist for them",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    if args.repeats and (args.mode != "single" or args.deep):
        print(
            "ERROR: --repeats applies to --mode single without --deep in v1 "
            "(repeats subsume bestof's variance question; composing with "

            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    if args.heldout and (args.deep or args.mode == "bestof"):
        print(
            "ERROR: --heldout applies to --mode single|loop without --deep "
            "(held-out sets are harness-row grading universes)",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    hw = args.hardware  # bound to every row: speed/cost are hardware-class-specific

    global _FACTORY
    if args.factory:
        # FR-001: capture the EFFECTIVE serving config from the live endpoint
        # (observed fingerprint — engine defaults, no recipe pins; what ran is
        # recorded verbatim, not the intention).
        try:
            probe = {
                "model": args.model,
                "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
                "max_tokens": 1,
                "temperature": 0.0,
            }
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                _completions_url(args.host),

                _auth_headers(args.host),

            pr = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))

                "model_requested": args.model,

                "system_fingerprint": pr.get("system_fingerprint"),
                "observed_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
                "note": "engine-default serving config as observed from the "
                         "live endpoint (no recipe/reasoning pins; template-"
                         "default behavior; bare prompt)",
            }
            print(
                f"FACTORY baseline: requested {args.model} served "
                f"{_FACTORY['model_served']} "
                f"(fingerprint {_FACTORY['system_fingerprint']}) — every row "
                "carries recipe 'factory-default (engine defaults)'",
                flush=True,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(
                f"ERROR: --factory requires a live endpoint to capture the "
                f"effective serving config: {type(e).__name__}: {e}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            raise SystemExit(2) from e

    if args.battery in ("realrepo", "refactor"):
        _rr = _load_battery(
            "batteries/realrepo_tasks.py" if args.battery == "realrepo"
            else "batteries/refactor_items.py"
        )
        assert _rr.selfcheck(), f"{args.battery} selfcheck failed — refusing to run"
        out_path = f"results/fcb15-{args.tag}.jsonl"
        done_rr: set[int] = set()
        if os.path.exists(out_path):
            for ln in open_or_die(out_path, "r"):
                try:
                    r = json.loads(ln)
                    if r.get("battery") == args.battery and r["model"] == args.model:
                        done_rr.add(r["item"])
                except Exception:
                    pass
        _items = _rr.TASKS if args.battery == "realrepo" else _rr.ITEMS
        n_items = len(_items) if not args.items else min(len(_items), args.items)
        t_run0 = time.monotonic()
        with open_or_die(out_path, "a") as out:
            for i in range(n_items):
                if i in done_rr:
                    continue
                if args.budget and time.monotonic() - t_run0 > args.budget:
                    print(
                        f"BUDGET STOP: {args.budget} s wall budget exceeded — "
                        f"partial run ({i}/{n_items} tasks); relaunch to resume "
                        "from the JSONL",
                        flush=True,
                    )
                    break
                prompt = _rr.task_prompt(i)
                last = None
                for a in range(3):
                    try:
                        payload = {
                            "model": args.model,
                            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                            "max_tokens": 6000,
                            "temperature": 0.0,
                        }
                        req = urllib.request.Request(
                            _completions_url(args.host),
                            json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                            _auth_headers(args.host),
                        )
                        t0 = time.time()
                        resp = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300))
                        dt = time.time() - t0
                        content = resp["choices"][0]["message"].get("content") or ""
                        grade = _rr.grade_answer(i, content)
                        if args.battery == "realrepo":
                            row = {
                                "model": args.model,
                                "item": i,
                                "phase": "realrepo",
                                "hardware": hw,
                                "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                                "battery": "realrepo",
                                "resolve": grade["resolve"],
                                "regression": grade["regression"],
                                "touched_failures": grade["touched_failures"],
                                "untouched_failures": grade["untouched_failures"],
                                **({"error": grade["error"]} if grade["error"] else {}),
                                "wall": round(dt, 1),
                                "content_tail": content[-120:],
                                **usage_fields(resp),
                            }
                            print(
                                f"task {i + 1}: {'RESOLVED' if grade['resolve'] else 'UNRESOLVED'}"
                                + (f" | regression {grade['regression']}"
                                   if grade["regression"] else "")
                                + (f" | {grade['error']}" if grade["error"] else "")
                                + f" ({dt:.1f}s)",
                                flush=True,
                            )
                        else:
                            row = {
                                "model": args.model,
                                "item": i,
                                "phase": "refactor",
                                "hardware": hw,
                                "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                                "battery": "refactor",
                                "ok": grade["ok"],
                                "behavior_ok": grade["behavior_ok"],
                                "stale_ok": grade["stale_ok"],
                                "import_ok": grade["import_ok"],
                                "stale_sites": grade["stale_sites"],
                                "behavior_failures": grade["behavior_failures"],
                                **({"stale_error": grade["stale_error"]}
                                   if grade["stale_error"] else {}),
                                **({"error": grade["error"]} if grade["error"] else {}),
                                "wall": round(dt, 1),
                                "content_tail": content[-120:],
                                **usage_fields(resp),
                            }
                            print(
                                f"task {i + 1}: {'PASS' if grade['ok'] else 'FAIL'}"
                                f" (behavior={grade['behavior_ok']} "
                                f"stale={grade['stale_ok']} "
                                f"import={grade['import_ok']})"
                                + (f" | stale sites {len(grade['stale_sites'])}"
                                   if not grade["stale_ok"] else "")
                                + (f" | {grade['error']}" if grade["error"] else "")
                                + f" ({dt:.1f}s)",
                                flush=True,
                            )
                        out.write(json.dumps({**row, **_factory_stamp(), "battery_version":
                            _BATTERY_VERSION}) + "\n")
                        out.flush()
                        break
                    except Exception as e:
                        last = e
                        time.sleep(3 * (a + 1))
                if last is not None:
                    print(
                        f"ERROR: {args.battery} task {i + 1} failed hard "
                        f"({type(last).__name__}: {last}) — pre-registered stop "
                        "condition: fail loud, never blind-retry past a wedged "
                        "completion path; resume-safe JSONL picks up on relaunch",
                        flush=True,
                    )
                    raise SystemExit(2) from last
        # summary over ALL rows (incl. resumed)
        rows = []
        for ln_no, ln in enumerate(open_or_die(out_path, "r"), 1):
            if args.model not in ln:
                continue
            try:
                r = json.loads(ln)
                if r.get("battery") == args.battery and r["model"] == args.model:
                    rows.append(r)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                print(f"ERROR: {out_path}:{ln_no}: malformed JSON row: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                raise SystemExit(2) from e
        _arms = _load_battery("scripts/arms_summary.py")
        n = len(rows)
        hw_tag = f" [{hw}]" if hw else ""
        part_tag = f" | PARTIAL ({len(rows)}/{n_items} tasks)" if len(rows) < n_items else ""
        if n:
            if args.battery == "realrepo":
                res_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["resolve"])
                reg_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["regression"])
                unt_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("untouched_failures"))
                lo_r, hi_r = _arms.wilson(res_n, n)
                lo_g, hi_g = _arms.wilson(reg_n, n)
                print(
                    f"\nSUMMARY {args.model} [{args.tag}]{hw_tag}: REALREPO "
                    f"resolve {res_n}/{n} (Wilson 95% CI [{lo_r:.2f}, {hi_r:.2f}]) "
                    f"| regression {reg_n}/{n} (CI [{lo_g:.2f}, {hi_g:.2f}]) "
                    f"| untouched-only regressions {unt_n}{part_tag}",
                    flush=True,
                )
            else:
                ok_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["ok"])
                beh_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["behavior_ok"])
                stale_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["stale_ok"])
                imp_n = sum(1 for r in rows if r["import_ok"])
                lo, hi = _arms.wilson(ok_n, n)
                print(
                    f"\nSUMMARY {args.model} [{args.tag}]{hw_tag}: REFACTOR "
                    f"pass {ok_n}/{n} (Wilson 95% CI [{lo:.2f}, {hi:.2f}]) "
                    f"| behavior {beh_n}/{n} | stale-clean {stale_n}/{n} "
                    f"| import-clean {imp_n}/{n}{part_tag}",
                    flush=True,
                )
        else:
            print(
                f"\nSUMMARY {args.model} [{args.tag}]{hw_tag}: "
                f"{args.battery.upper()} no rows on disk",
                flush=True,
            )
        return

    global ITEMS, REFS, WRONG, GRADE_MODE, _t_ITEMS, _cbi, _cmi, _rsi, _deep, _hl, _rs

    if args.battery == "combined":
        _t = _load_battery("batteries/traps14_items.py")
        _t_ITEMS = {15 + i: pe for i, pe in enumerate(_t.ITEMS)}  # traps rows live at idx>=15
        ITEMS = list(ITEMS) + [(p, None) for p, _ in _t.ITEMS]
        REFS = list(REFS) + list(_t.REFS)
        WRONG = list(WRONG) + ["print('DELIBERATELY WRONG')"] * len(_t.ITEMS)
        assert selfcheck(), "combined selfcheck failed"
    elif args.battery == "traps":
        _t = _load_battery("batteries/traps14_items.py")
        _BATTERY_VERSION = str(getattr(_t, "BATTERY_VERSION", "v1"))
        _t_ITEMS = _t.ITEMS  # (prompt, expected) for traps rows
        ITEMS = [(p, None) for p, _ in _t.ITEMS]
        REFS = _t.REFS
        WRONG = ["print('DELIBERATELY WRONG')"] * len(ITEMS)
        GRADE_MODE = "stdout"
        assert selfcheck(), "traps selfcheck failed"
    elif args.battery == "rsi":
        _rsi = _load_battery("batteries/rsi4_items.py")
        ITEMS = _rsi.ITEMS  # (prompt, task_idx) pairs
        REFS = _rsi.REFS
        WRONG = _rsi.WRONG  # list-of-lists (regress probe, broken probe)
        GRADE_MODE = "rsi"
        assert selfcheck(), "rsi selfcheck failed — refusing to run"
    elif args.battery == "sli":
        _sli = _load_battery("batteries/sli10_items.py")
        ITEMS = _sli.ITEMS  # (spec, harness) pairs — check-mode, same as fcb15
        REFS = _sli.REFS
        WRONG = _sli.WRONG
        GRADE_MODE = "check"
        assert selfcheck(), "sli selfcheck failed — refusing to run"
    elif args.battery == "cbi":
        _cbi = _load_battery("batteries/cbi10_items.py")
        ITEMS = [(task, None) for task, _p in _cbi.ITEMS]
        REFS = _cbi.REFS
        WRONG = _cbi.WRONG  # list-of-lists; _all_wrongs flattens
        _t_ITEMS = _cbi.ITEMS
        GRADE_MODE = "cbi"
        assert selfcheck(), "cbi selfcheck failed — refusing to run"
    elif args.battery == "cmi":
        _cmi = _load_battery("batteries/cmi10_items.py")
        ITEMS = [(task, None) for task, _g, _f in _cmi.ITEMS]
        REFS = _cmi.REFS
        WRONG = _cmi.WRONG
        _t_ITEMS = _cmi.ITEMS
        GRADE_MODE = "cmi"
        assert selfcheck(), "cmi selfcheck failed — refusing to run"
    else:
        if args.deep:
            _deep = _load_battery("batteries/fcb15_deep.py")
            assert _deep.selfcheck(), "deep-layer selfcheck failed — refusing to run"
        assert selfcheck(), "battery selfcheck failed — refusing to run"

    heldout_gen = None
    if args.heldout:
        _heldout = _load_battery("scripts/heldout.py")
        if not _heldout.check_active(args.heldout):
            raise SystemExit(2)
        _ho = _heldout._load(args.heldout)[0]
        ITEMS, REFS, WRONG, GRADE_MODE = list(_ho.ITEMS), list(_ho.REFS), list(_ho.WRONG), "check"
        heldout_gen = args.heldout
        print(
            f"held-out generation {heldout_gen}: {len(ITEMS)} items (private, machine-local)",
            flush=True,
        )
        assert selfcheck(), "held-out selfcheck failed — refusing to run"

    _hl = None
    if args.mode in ("loop", "verifier"):
        _hl = _load_battery("scripts/harness_loop.py")
        assert _hl.selfcheck(ITEMS), "harness-loop selfcheck failed — refusing to run"

    out_path = f"results/fcb15-{args.tag}.jsonl"
    # spec 048: agent arms key the resume cells on (model, item, agent,
    # agents_md) — legacy direct rows never mask agent cells and vice versa
    _agent_mod = None
    _agents_md_path = _agents_md_sha = None
    _arm_budget = 0.0
    if args.agent != "none":
        _agent_mod = _load_battery("scripts/agents/adapter.py")
        if args.agents_md is None:
            print("ERROR: --agents-md is required when --agent != none", file=sys.stderr)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        if args.agent not in _agent_mod.IMPLEMENTED:
            print(f"ERROR: agent {args.agent!r} is not implemented (declared in "
                  "spec 047, lands in 050)", file=sys.stderr)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        _agents_md_path, _agents_md_sha = _agent_mod.verify_label(args.agents_md)
        try:
            _arm_budget = float(os.environ.get("GEFC_WALL_BUDGET_S", "0") or 0)
        except ValueError:
            _arm_budget = 0.0  # malformed env: unbounded (the documented default)
        _budget_tag = f"{_arm_budget:.0f}s" if _arm_budget else "unbounded"
        print(f"agent arm: {args.agent} | agents_md={args.agents_md}@"
              f"{(_agents_md_sha or '?')[:12]} | arm budget {_budget_tag}", flush=True)
    done: set[tuple] = set()  # (model, item[, repeat]) — legacy rows use the 2-tuple
    if os.path.exists(out_path):
        for line in open_or_die(out_path, "r"):
            try:
                r = json.loads(line)
                if args.agent != "none":
                    # only THIS agent arm's rows count as done
                    if (r.get("agent") == args.agent
                            and r.get("agents_md") == args.agents_md):
                        done.add((r["model"], r["item"]))
                elif str(r.get("phase", "")).startswith("rep"):
                    done.add((r["model"], r["item"], r.get("repeat")))
                elif "agent" not in r or r.get("agent", "none") == "none":
                    done.add((r["model"], r["item"]))  # legacy row: R=1 key
            except Exception:
                pass

    greedy_ok = retry_ok = 0
    n_items = len(ITEMS) if not args.items else min(len(ITEMS), args.items)
    t_run0 = time.monotonic()
    _rs = _load_battery("scripts/runstate.py") if args.mode == "loop" else None
    if _rs:
        _rs.begin(
            args.tag,
            budget_s=args.budget or None,
            model=args.model,
            mode="loop",
            battery=args.battery,
            heldout=heldout_gen,
        )
    order = list(range(n_items))
    if args.shuffle_seed is not None:
        _armod = _load_battery("scripts/arms_summary.py")
        order = _armod.shuffle_order(n_items, args.shuffle_seed)
    with open_or_die(out_path, "a") as out:
        for i in order:
            if args.repeats and any((args.model, i, r) in done for r in range(1, args.repeats + 1)):
                continue
            if not args.repeats and (args.model, i) in done:
                continue
            if args.budget and time.monotonic() - t_run0 > args.budget:
                print(
                    f"BUDGET STOP: {args.budget} s wall budget exceeded — partial "
                    f"run ({i}/{n_items} items reached); relaunch to resume "
                    "from the JSONL",
                    flush=True,
                )
                break
            if args.repeats:
                for r_idx in range(1, args.repeats + 1):
                    if (args.model, i, r_idx) in done:
                        continue
                    rep_row = one(i, args.model, args.host, 0.7, seed=2000 + r_idx)
                    row = {
                        "model": args.model,
                        "item": i,
