    direct_row = next(r for r in range(2)
                      if qr.nth(r).get_attribute("data-agent") == "none")
    a_cells = qr.nth(agent_row).locator("td").all_inner_texts()
    d_cells = qr.nth(direct_row).locator("td").all_inner_texts()
    assert a_cells[0].strip() == "pi", f"agent row leads with pi, got {a_cells[:2]}"
    assert a_cells[1].strip() == "base", f"AGENTS.md cell = base, got {a_cells[1]}"
    assert d_cells[0].strip() == "direct", f"direct row cell0, got {d_cells[:2]}"
    assert d_cells[1].strip() == "—", f"direct row AGENTS.md = em-dash, got {d_cells[1]}"
    print("OBSERVED ranking columns: agent row = pi/base, direct row = direct/—")

    # click the AGENT row -> the dialog carries the invocation fingerprint
    qr.nth(agent_row).click()
    page.wait_for_selector("#qr-dialog[open]")
    dlg_text = page.locator("#qr-dialog").inner_text()
    for needle in ("agent", "AGENTS.md", "sandbox", "per-item wall cap",
                   "sha256 aaaaaaaaaaaa"):
        assert needle in dlg_text, f"agent popup missing {needle!r}: {dlg_text}"
    page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    page.wait_for_function("!document.getElementById('qr-dialog').open")

    # click the DIRECT row -> NO agent section (never an empty stub)
    qr.nth(direct_row).click()
    page.wait_for_selector("#qr-dialog[open]")
    d_text = page.locator("#qr-dialog").inner_text()
    assert "sandbox" not in d_text, "direct popup must not carry an agent section"
    assert "wall cap" not in d_text, "direct popup must not carry a wall cap"
    page.keyboard.press("Escape")

    # the Arms table leads with the same two columns
    arms_head = page.locator("section:has-text('Arms table') th").all_inner_texts()
    assert arms_head[0] == "agent" and arms_head[1] == "AGENTS.md", arms_head[:3]
    print("OBSERVED popup: agent row fingerprint complete; direct row clean")
    browser.close()

print("JOURNEY 049: PASS")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Journey 052 — GE panel badge, driven as the operator (spec 052 US1-3).

Runs on file:// (static page — no server, no ports). Chromium from
~/.cache/ms-playwright. Asserts USER OUTCOMES (rendered text + the sort
still working with badges attached), never HTTP or substring proxies on
the source.
"""

import importlib.util
import os
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
RESULTS = os.path.expanduser(
    "~/Piero/Work/Good-Enough-For-Coding/results")

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "pb", os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "panel_build.py"))
if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("cannot load panel_build")
pb = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(pb)

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="j052-")
out_html = os.path.join(tmp, "panel.html")
pb.build(RESULTS, os.path.join(tmp, "d.json"), out_html)

sync_playwright = importlib.import_module(
    "playwright.sync_api").sync_playwright

fails = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + name + (f" — {detail}" if detail and not cond else ""))
    if not cond:
        fails.append(name)


with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto("file://" + out_html)
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # the panel collapses its sections; the operator opens them — so does
    # the journey (reading collapsed <details> returns empty text)
    for sec in ("#ts-sec", "#arms-sec"):
        page.locator(f"{sec} > summary").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(100)

    # US1: the Arms table carries a GE column with real verdict text
    ge_th = page.locator("#arms-sec th[title*='graduation verdict']")
    check("arms GE header present", ge_th.count() == 1)
    arms_cells = page.locator("#arms-sec td .ge-badge")
    texts = [arms_cells.nth(i).inner_text() for i in range(arms_cells.count())]
    check("arms badges rendered", len(texts) > 0, f"{len(texts)} badges")
    full = [t for t in texts if "provisional" in t or "sealed" in t]
    check("at least one full verdict (provisional/sealed)",
          len(full) > 0, str(texts[:4]))

    # US2: ranking rows carry the compact badge; tooltip keeps the verdict
    rank = page.locator(".qr-row .ge-badge")
    comp = [rank.nth(i).inner_text() for i in range(rank.count())]
    check("ranking compact badges rendered", len(comp) > 0, str(comp[:6]))
    check("compact forms only (GE✓/GE?/—)",
          all(t in ("GE✓", "GE?", "—") for t in comp), str(comp[:6]))
    if rank.count():
        tip = rank.first.get_attribute("title") or ""
        check("badge tooltip carries gates",
              "G1" in tip and "pooled" in tip, tip[:80])

    # US3: the legend teaches the ladder (floors from config)
    legend = page.locator("text=GE ladder (sealed)")
    check("ladder legend line visible", legend.count() >= 1)
    body = page.inner_text("body")
    check("legend floors + phrases",
          "0.70" in body and "0.80" in body and "two sessions" in body
          and "recomputed" in body)

    # the sort still works with badges attached (US2: badge is not a key)
    rows_before = page.locator(".qr-row td").first.inner_text()
    page.locator("#ts-sec th").first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(150)
    rows_after = page.locator(".qr-row td").first.inner_text()
    badge_count_before = rank.count()
    check("sort click responded (row set stable, badges intact)",
          True, f"first cell {rows_before[:20]} -> {rows_after[:20]}")
    check("badges survive a sort",
          page.locator(".qr-row .ge-badge").count() == badge_count_before)

    page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(tmp, "journey052.png"), full_page=False)
    browser.close()

print(f"\nscreenshot: {tmp}/journey052.png")
if fails:
    print(f"JOURNEY FAILED: {fails}")
    sys.exit(1)
print("JOURNEY PASSED (US1 arms badge, US2 ranking compact + tooltip, "
      "US3 legend, sort integrity)")
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""model_onboard — measure a freshly downloaded model BEFORE it runs any
battery (operator 2026-09-04): sha256 + size + PPL (+ KLD vs an anchor's
saved logits) land in the panel registries the moment weights hit disk, so
a greyed pipeline row (TRAPS phase) already shows its identity.

Protocol (identical to the 2026-08-31 PRP campaign, /tmp/prp on the .15):
  corpus  batteries/corpus/wiki.test.raw  (wikitext-2 test raw, 1290590 B,
          sha256 173c87a5... — the campaign's cosmo.zip mirror, vendored)
  ppl     llama-perplexity -m GGUF -f CORPUS -c 1024 --chunks 12
  kld     same + --kl-divergence --kl-divergence-base ANCHOR_LOGITS
  anchor  --make-anchor: -m GGUF ... --save-all-logits OUT (one-time per
          anchor; the flash-next M64 Q5 logits are the house anchor)

Registries (atomic replace, never hand-edited):
  results/prp-kld.json    arm -> {ppl, kld, corpus, ctx, chunks, ...}
  results/gguf-sha.jsonl  {gguf, size_gib, sha256, date} append rows

Fail-loud: unparsed output or non-zero exit writes NOTHING and exits 1.
Stdlib only. Run ON the box that holds the weights (the .15 test box —
strixy2's repo-build llama-perplexity core-dumps, 2026-09-04).

Self-check: uv run python3 scripts/model_onboard.py --selfcheck
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.join(HERE, "..")
CORPUS = os.path.join(ROOT, "batteries", "corpus", "wiki.test.raw")
PRP = os.path.join(ROOT, "results", "prp-kld.json")
SHAJ = os.path.join(ROOT, "results", "gguf-sha.jsonl")
DEFAULT_BIN = os.path.expanduser(
    "~/Qwen-3.8-27B_Strix-Halo_gfx1151/llama.cpp/build-vk/bin/llama-perplexity")

_PPL_RE = re.compile(r"Final estimate: PPL = ([0-9.]+)(?: \+/- ([0-9.]+))?")
_KLD_RE = re.compile(
    r"Final estimate: KL divergence: ([0-9.e+-]+)(?: \+/- ([0-9.e+-]+))?")


def sha256_of(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            for blk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 24), b""):
                h.update(blk)
    except OSError as e:
        raise SystemExit(f"cannot read {path}: {e}") from e
    return h.hexdigest()


def run_bin(binpath, argv, timeout=1800):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(binpath))
    p = subprocess.run([os.path.abspath(binpath)] + argv,
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, env=env)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(p.stdout[-2000:] + p.stderr[-2000:])
        raise SystemExit(f"llama-perplexity exited {p.returncode}")
    return p.stdout + p.stderr


def parse_final(text, rx, label):
    m = None
    for m_ in rx.finditer(text):
        m = m_  # keep the LAST match (the final estimate)
    if m is None:
        sys.stderr.write(text[-2000:])
        raise SystemExit(f"no {label} estimate in output — refusing to write")
    try:
        v = float(m.group(1))
        ci = float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else None
    except ValueError as e:
        raise SystemExit(f"unparsable {label} numbers: {m.groups()!r}") from e
    return v, ci


def atomic_json(path, obj):
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(path))
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=1)
        f.write("\n")
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(__doc__ or "model_onboard").splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("--gguf", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--arm", help="registry key in results/prp-kld.json")
    ap.add_argument("--anchor-logits",
                    help="saved logits file for --kl-divergence")
    ap.add_argument("--make-anchor", metavar="OUT",
                    help="just run PPL and SAVE this model's logits to OUT "
                         "(creates/replaces an anchor)")
    ap.add_argument("--bin", default=DEFAULT_BIN)
    ap.add_argument("--corpus", default=CORPUS)
    ap.add_argument("--ctx", type=int, default=1024)
    ap.add_argument("--chunks", type=int, default=12)
    a = ap.parse_args()

    if not os.path.exists(a.gguf):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing gguf: {a.gguf}")
    if not os.path.exists(a.corpus):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing corpus: {a.corpus} (vendor it first)")

    base = ["-m", os.path.abspath(a.gguf), "-f", os.path.abspath(a.corpus),
            "-c", str(a.ctx), "--chunks", str(a.chunks)]

    if a.make_anchor:
        out = run_bin(a.bin, base + ["--save-all-logits", a.make_anchor])
        ppl, ci = parse_final(out, _PPL_RE, "PPL")
        print(f"anchor logits saved: {a.make_anchor} (ppl {ppl:.4f})")
        return

    if not a.arm:
        raise SystemExit("--arm required (the prp-kld.json key)")

    out = run_bin(a.bin, base)
    ppl, ci = parse_final(out, _PPL_RE, "PPL")
    kld = kld_ci = None
    if a.anchor_logits:
        # batch pinned to 1024: the unpinned KLD mode picks batch 2048 /
        # n_seq 2 and dies on Vulkan before the final estimate (OBSERVED
        # 2026-09-04; the 2026-08-31 campaign ran 1024/1 — /tmp/prp logs)
        #
        # KNOWN DEFECT (OBSERVED 2026-09-04, fork build b10730 on .15):
        # even at 1024/1 the KLD run EXITS RC=0 right after the "ETA"
        # line with NO final estimate — not a segfault (journal clean);
        # suspect the --save-all-logits anchor shape vs the campaign's
        # ad-hoc invocation. PPL is unaffected. RE-TEST at the mainline
        # llama.cpp migration (operator directive 2026-09-04: all boxes
        # move to mainline bleeding-edge builds) — if the defect is gone
        # there, delete this note and re-run KLD for the affected arms.
        out2 = run_bin(a.bin, base + ["-b", "1024", "--kl-divergence",
                                      "--kl-divergence-base", a.anchor_logits])
        kld, kld_ci = parse_final(out2, _KLD_RE, "KL")

    sha = sha256_of(a.gguf)
    size_gib = round(os.path.getsize(a.gguf) / 2**30, 1)
    reg = {}
    if os.path.exists(PRP):
        try:
            with open(PRP) as f:
                reg = json.load(f)
        except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"{PRP} is unreadable/corrupt — fix it before writing "
                f"(config is sacred): {e}") from e
    reg[a.arm] = {
        "ppl": ppl, "ppl_ci": ci, "kld": kld, "kld_ci": kld_ci,
        "corpus": f"wikitext-2 test raw (vendored, {os.path.getsize(a.corpus)} B)",
        "ctx": a.ctx, "chunks": a.chunks,
        "gguf": os.path.abspath(a.gguf), "sha256": sha,
        "ref": a.anchor_logits or "self",
        "date": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
    }
    atomic_json(PRP, reg)
    try:
        with open(SHAJ, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({
                "gguf": os.path.basename(a.gguf), "size_gib": size_gib,
                "sha256": sha, "date": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}) + "\n")
    except OSError as e:
        raise SystemExit(f"cannot append {SHAJ}: {e}") from e
    print(f"{a.arm}: ppl {ppl:.4f}" + (f" ± {ci:.3f}" if ci else "")
          + (f" · kld {kld:.6f}" if kld is not None else "")
          + f" · {size_gib} GiB · sha {sha[:12]} — registries updated")


def selfcheck():
    ppl = parse_final("Perplexity: 2.1\nFinal estimate: PPL = 2.345 +/- 0.055\n", _PPL_RE, "PPL")
    assert ppl[0] == 2.345 and ppl[1] == 0.055, ppl
    kld = parse_final("Final estimate: KL divergence: 0.265258 +/- 0.008791", _KLD_RE, "KLD")
    assert kld[0] == 0.265258 and kld[1] == 0.008791, kld
    kld2 = parse_final("Final estimate: KL divergence: 0.19", _KLD_RE, "KLD")
    assert kld2[0] == 0.19 and kld2[1] is None, kld2
    try:
        parse_final("no estimate here", _PPL_RE, "PPL")
        raise AssertionError("unparseable output must exit non-zero")
    except SystemExit:
        pass
    print("selfcheck OK: parsers bite, fail-loud holds")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if "--selfcheck" in sys.argv:
        selfcheck()
    else:
        main()
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""panel_build — canonical results file + instrument panel page (spec 001).

Usage:
  uv run python3 scripts/panel_build.py [results-dir]          # build from arms JSONLs
  uv run python3 scripts/panel_build.py --cells cells.json     # build from fixture cells
  uv run python3 scripts/panel_build.py --check               # validate dashboard.json only

Contract (spec 001 FR-002..FR-008):
  * results/dashboard.json is the canonical machine-readable file the panel
    reads — builder-written, never hand-edited. Per axis cell: value, Wilson
    95% CI, artifact path, setup 4-tuple (flavor · recipe · harness · rules),
    hardware class, date.
  * Every populated cell is derived from the run JSONLs via the SAME score
    rules as scripts/arms_summary.py (imported, not reimplemented).
  * Axes without data render "not measured" — sample numbers never appear.
  * Malformed JSONL rows / schema violations / missing 4-tuple elements fail
    loud (non-zero exit + explicit message).

Tier policy (FR-005, dashboard-default v1): Tier 2 floors RSI/SFI >= 50 cap 55;
Tier 3 floors SFI/SLI >= 80 cap 40; funnel = HRI x RSI/100 x SFI/100. Gates
apply only to OBSERVED cells; composites over partial data are labeled partial.
CEI is excluded from v1 composites (0-100 normalization policy is owned by
spec 008) — the exclusion is stated on the panel, not hidden.

RVI v1 stays the shots_used proxy (Q7): 100*(1 - mean(shots_used)/shots).

Stdlib only; Python 3.11+.
"""

import html
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from typing import NoReturn

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def _load_module(name: str, rel: str):
    """Load a sibling module (scripts/) by path — batteries/ and scripts/ are
    not packages; sys.path games break static resolution."""
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), rel)
    )
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, f"missing {rel}"
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


arms_summary = _load_module("arms_summary", "arms_summary.py")
verdict_mod = _load_module("verdict", "verdict.py")
anchors_mod = _load_module("anchors", "anchors.py")

OUT_JSON = "results/dashboard.json"
OUT_HTML = "docs/instrument_panel.html"

HARNESS = "fcb15_run.py (scripted loop)"
RULES = {
    "single": "one-shot prompt; temp 0 greedy + one retry @ temp 0.6",
    "bestof": "best-of-5 @ temp 0.7 (seeded), early stop on solve",
}
OPERATOR_RECIPE = "coding"  # Q5/D7: crown holder until spec 006/007 data

AXIS_LABELS = {

    "hri": "HRI · Task Resolve Rate (%, with-retry / best-of-5)",

    "sfi": "SFI · Silent-Failure Immunity",

    "cei": "CEI · Cost Efficiency (graded-correct per unit)",
}
SCORE_AXES = ["rci", "hri", "rsi", "sfi", "cbi", "rvi", "sli"]  # 0-100 axes

# v1 dashboard-default policy, verbatim from docs/good_enough_dashboard.html
TIERS = {

def die(msg) -> NoReturn:
    sys.exit(f"panel_build ERROR: {msg}")


def read_json_or_die(path, what):
    try:
        return json.loads(open(path).read())
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
        die(f"cannot read {what} {path}: {e}")


def read_rows_or_die(path):
    try:
        return [json.loads(ln) for ln in open(path)]
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
        die(f"cannot read {path}: {e}")


def write_text_or_die(path, text, what):
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    except OSError as e:
        die(f"cannot write {what} {path}: {e}")


def require(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        die(msg)


def validate_row(r, tag, i):
    """FR-007: malformed JSONL rows fail loud, with row identity."""
    where = f"{tag} row {i}"
    require(isinstance(r, dict), f"{where}: not a JSON object")
    for k in ("model", "item", "phase", "ok"):
        require(k in r, f"{where}: missing required key '{k}'")
    require(isinstance(r["ok"], bool), f"{where}: 'ok' is not a boolean")
    if r["phase"] in ("greedy", "retry06", "shot0", "bestof"):
        pass
    if "wall" in r:
        require(isinstance(r["wall"], (int, float)), f"{where}: 'wall' is not a number")


def validate_cell(c):
    """FR-008: a cell without its full 4-tuple (or hardware/date/artifact) is
    rejected at build time — a number without its tuple is not comparable."""
    for k in ("axis", "config", "value", "artifact", "tuple", "hardware", "date"):
        require(k in c, f"cell missing key '{k}': {json.dumps(c)[:120]}")
    t = c["tuple"]
    require(isinstance(t, dict), "cell tuple must be an object")
    for k in ("flavor", "recipe", "harness", "rules"):
        require(t.get(k), f"cell tuple missing '{k}': {json.dumps(c)[:120]}")
    require(c["date"], "cell missing date")
    require(
        isinstance(c["value"], (int, float)), f"cell value must be numeric: {json.dumps(c)[:120]}"
    )


def artifact_date(path, rows):
    """Newest row stamp if the runner recorded one; else the artifact's mtime
    (day granularity) — provenance recorded in the cell detail."""
    ts = [r.get("ts") for r in rows if r.get("ts")]
    if ts:
        return max(ts), "row 'ts' stamps"
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(path)).strftime(
        "%Y-%m-%d"
    ), "artifact mtime (rows predate 'ts' stamping)"


def cells_from_arm(rdir, tag, mode, recipe_key):
    """Derive axis cells for one arm from its JSONL, using arms_summary score
    rules. Returns (cells, missing_reason_or_None)."""
    path = os.path.join(rdir, f"fcb15-{tag}.jsonl")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None, "no artifact"
    rows = read_rows_or_die(path)
    if not rows:
        return None, "empty artifact"
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        validate_row(r, tag, i)

    model = rows[0]["model"]
    hw = next((r.get("hardware") for r in rows if r.get("hardware")), None)
    require(
        hw,
        f"{tag}: rows carry no --hardware stamp; speed/cost cells are "
        f"hardware-bound (re-run with --hardware, constitution II)",
    )
    date, dprov = artifact_date(path, rows)
    art = os.path.relpath(path)
    tup = {"flavor": model, "recipe": recipe_key, "harness": HARNESS, "rules": RULES[mode]}
    base = {
        "config": "alone",
        "artifact": art,
        "tuple": tup,
        "hardware": hw,
        "date": date,
        "detail": {"date_source": dprov},
    }

    cells = []

    def add(axis, value, unit, k=None, n=None, **extra):
        c: dict = dict(base, axis=axis, value=value, unit=unit)
        if k is not None and n and n > 0:
            c["ci95"] = [round(v, 4) for v in arms_summary.wilson(k, n)]
            c["k"] = k
            c["n"] = n
        c.update(extra)
        validate_cell(c)
        cells.append(c)

    if mode == "single":
        g = [r for r in rows if r["phase"] == "greedy"]
        rt = [r for r in rows if r["phase"] == "retry06"]
        if g:
            k, n = sum(r["ok"] for r in g), len(g)
            add("rci", round(100 * k / n, 1), "% correct", k=k, n=n)
            rs = k + sum(r["ok"] for r in rt)
            add(
                "hri",
                round(100 * rs / n, 1),
                "% resolved",
                k=rs,
                n=n,
                detail=dict(base["detail"], phase="with-retry"),
            )
        else:
            return [], "no greedy rows"
    else:
        b = [r for r in rows if r["phase"] == "bestof"]
        if b:
            k, n = sum(r["ok"] for r in b), len(b)
            add(
                "hri",
                round(100 * k / n, 1),
                "% resolved",
                k=k,
                n=n,
                detail=dict(base["detail"], phase="best-of-5"),
            )
            shots = [r["shots_used"] for r in b if "shots_used" in r]
            if shots:
                add(
                    "rvi",
                    round(100 * (1 - (sum(shots) / len(shots) - 1) / 4), 1),
                    "% (proxy)",
                    shots_used=shots,
                    detail=dict(
                        base["detail"],
                        formula="100*(1-(mean(shots_used)-1)/4): "
                        "first-shot solves=100, full budget=0 "
                        "(Q7 proxy; explicit --repeats parked)",
                    ),
                )
        else:
            return [], "no bestof rows"

    # CEI (FR-006): graded-correct per unit, from completion rows with wall;
    # per-token only over rows that carry usage (coverage stated, never faked).
    # Row coverage too: compacted bestof artifacts keep few shot rows — the
    # cell must say which fraction of items it was computed over.
    n_items = len({r["item"] for r in rows})
    comp = [r for r in rows if r["phase"] in ("greedy", "retry06") or r["phase"].startswith("shot")]
    wall_total = sum(r["wall"] for r in comp if "wall" in r)
    if wall_total > 0:
        add(
            "cei",
            round(sum(r["ok"] for r in comp) / wall_total, 4),
            "correct/wall-s",
            detail=dict(
                base["detail"],
                phase="wall",
                wall_s=round(wall_total, 1),
                row_coverage=f"{len(comp)} rows/{n_items} items",
            ),
        )
        with_u = [r for r in comp if r.get("total_tokens") is not None]
        if with_u:
            tok_total = sum(r["total_tokens"] for r in with_u)
            add(
                "cei",
                round(sum(r["ok"] for r in with_u) / tok_total, 6),
                "correct/token",
                detail=dict(
                    base["detail"],
                    phase="token",
                    tokens=tok_total,
                    coverage=f"{len(with_u)}/{len(comp)}",
                    row_coverage=f"{len(comp)} rows/{n_items} items",
                ),
            )
    return cells, None


def row_axis_values(cells):
    """Panel-row value per axis: prefer the operator recipe's cells (Q5/D7),
    else the newest by date; alternates stay visible in the cells table."""
    by_axis = {}
    for c in cells:
        by_axis.setdefault(c["axis"], []).append(c)
    out = {}
    for axis, cs in by_axis.items():
        cs2 = sorted(
            cs, key=lambda c: (c["tuple"]["recipe"] == OPERATOR_RECIPE, c["date"]), reverse=True
        )
        out[axis] = cs2[0]
    return out


def tier_view(values, tier):
    """Composite over measured 0-100 axes (weights renormalized; cei excluded —
    normalization owned by spec 008), gates only on OBSERVED axes (FR-005)."""
    measured = {
        a: v["value"] for a, v in values.items() if a in SCORE_AXES and v["value"] is not None
    }
    unmeasured = [a for a in SCORE_AXES if a not in measured]
    wsum = sum(tier["weights"][a] for a in measured)
    comp = sum(tier["weights"][a] * measured[a] for a in measured) / wsum if wsum else None
    fired = []
    capped = comp
    for gate in tier["gates"]:
        v = measured.get(gate["metric"])
        if v is not None and v < gate["min"]:
            fired.append({**gate, "observed": v})
            capped = gate["cap"] if capped is None else min(capped, gate["cap"])
    return {
        "name": tier["name"],
        "desc": tier["desc"],
        "composite": round(comp, 1) if comp is not None else None,
        "capped_to": round(capped, 1) if (fired and capped is not None) else None,
        "gates_fired": fired,
        "measured": measured,
        "unmeasured": unmeasured,
        "partial": bool(unmeasured),
        "cei_note": (
            "CEI excluded from v1 composite — 0-100 normalization policy owned by spec 008"
        ),
    }


def funnel_view(values):
    """HRI x RSI/100 x SFI/100 — only from OBSERVED cells; else not measured."""
    parts = {a: values[a]["value"] for a in ("hri", "rsi", "sfi") if a in values}
    missing = [a for a in ("hri", "rsi", "sfi") if a not in parts]
    if missing:
        return {
            "value": None,
            "missing": missing,
            "status": f"not measured (missing: {', '.join(missing)})",
        }
    v = parts["hri"] / 100 * parts["rsi"] / 100 * parts["sfi"] / 100
    return {
        "value": round(100 * v, 1),
        "missing": [],
        "status": f"{round(100 * v, 1)}% trustworthy-rate",
    }

def _battery_base(path: str, rows: list, harness: str = "none",
                  rules: str = "none (bare prompt)", recipe: str = "balanced") -> dict:
    # cells are heterogeneous (ci95 is a list, detail a dict) -> dict[str, Any]
    model = rows[0]["model"]
    hw = next((r.get("hardware") for r in rows if r.get("hardware")), None)
    require(hw, f"{os.path.basename(path)}: rows carry no --hardware stamp")
    date, dprov = artifact_date(path, rows)
    return {
        "config": "alone",
        "artifact": os.path.relpath(path),
        "tuple": {"flavor": model, "recipe": recipe, "harness": harness, "rules": rules},
        "hardware": hw,
        "date": date,
        "detail": {"date_source": dprov},
    }


def cells_from_battery(rdir, tag, recipe="Qwen38-27B-balanced (Q6 @ 128k)"):
    """Alone-row cells for the battery axes (spec 008 FR: panel wiring of
    CBI/SLI/RSI/SFI). Returns cells or None (not measured)."""
    path = os.path.join(rdir, f"fcb15-{tag}.jsonl")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    rows = read_rows_or_die(path)
    if not rows:
        return None
    base = _battery_base(path, rows)
    cells = []

    def add(axis, value, unit, k=None, n=None, **extra):
        c: dict = dict(base, axis=axis, value=value, unit=unit)
        if k is not None and n and n > 0:
            c["ci95"] = [round(v, 4) for v in arms_summary.wilson(k, n)]
            c["k"], c["n"] = k, n
        c.update(extra)
        validate_cell(c)
        cells.append(c)

    per_item = {}
    for r in rows:  # retry06 overwrites greedy (phase conventions)
        if r["phase"] in ("greedy", "retry06"):
            per_item[r["item"]] = r
    fin = list(per_item.values())
    if tag.endswith("cbi") or tag == "cbi001":
        k, n = sum(r["ok"] for r in fin), len(fin)
        if n:
            add("cbi", round(100 * k / n, 1), "% surfaced", k=k, n=n)
    elif tag.endswith("sli") or tag == "sli001":
        k, n = sum(r["ok"] for r in fin), len(fin)
        if n:
            add("sli", round(100 * k / n, 1), "% pass", k=k, n=n)
    elif tag.endswith("rsi") or tag == "rsi001":
        res = [r for r in fin if r.get("resolve_ok")]
        k, n = len(res), len(fin)
        if n:
            add(
                "rsi",
                round(100 * k / n, 1),
                "% resolve",
                k=k,
                n=n,
                detail={
                    **base["detail"],
                    "mean_rsi": round(sum(r.get("rsi", 0.0) for r in fin) / n, 3),
                    "regressions": sum(1 for r in fin if r.get("regression")),
                },
            )
    elif tag.endswith("deep") or tag == "deep001":
        sh = [r for r in fin if r["ok"]]
        silent = [r for r in sh if r.get("silent_failure")]
        if sh:
            lo, hi = arms_summary.wilson(len(silent), len(sh))
            add(
                "sfi",
                round(100 * (1 - len(silent) / len(sh)), 1),
                "% immune",
                k=len(silent),
                n=len(sh),
                ci95=[round(100 * (1 - hi), 2), round(100 * (1 - lo), 2)],
                detail={
                    **base["detail"],
                    "ci_inverted": True,
                    "note": "CI on the silent-failure proportion, inverted",
                },
            )
    return cells or None


def cells_from_loop(rdir, tag):
    """Harness-row cells (spec 006 loop runs): RCI resolve + CEI wall.
    config 'harness', 4-tuple harness slot 'scripted-loop v1'."""
    path = os.path.join(rdir, f"fcb15-{tag}.jsonl")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    rows = read_rows_or_die(path)
    loop_rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("phase") == "loop"]
    if not loop_rows:
        return None
    model = loop_rows[0]["model"]
    hw = next((r.get("hardware") for r in loop_rows if r.get("hardware")), None)
    require(hw, f"{tag}: loop rows carry no --hardware stamp")
    date, dprov = artifact_date(path, loop_rows)
    gen = next((r.get("heldout") for r in loop_rows if r.get("heldout")), None)
    base = {
        "config": "harness",
        "artifact": os.path.relpath(path),
        "tuple": {
            "flavor": model,
            "recipe": "coding",
            "harness": "scripted-loop v1",
            "rules": "write code + own test; one feedback retry; cap 2",
        },
        "hardware": hw,
        "date": date,
        "detail": {"date_source": dprov},
    }
    if gen:
        base["heldout"] = gen
    cells = []
    k, n = sum(r["ok"] for r in loop_rows), len(loop_rows)
    c: dict = dict(base, axis="rci", value=round(100 * k / n, 1), unit="% resolved")
    c["ci95"] = [round(v, 4) for v in arms_summary.wilson(k, n)]
    c["k"], c["n"] = k, n
    validate_cell(c)
    cells.append(c)
    walls = [sum(it.get("wall", 0) for it in r.get("iters", [])) for r in loop_rows]
    cei = dict(
        base,
        axis="cei",
        value=round(sum(walls) / len(walls), 1),
        unit="s/item (sum of loop iterations)",
        detail={**base["detail"], "cei_direction": "lower is better"},
    )
    validate_cell(cei)
    cells.append(cei)
    return cells

_QUANT_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:UD-|AD-)?Q\d(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)*(?:/(?:AD-)?Q\d(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)*)?\b"
    r"|(?:ROCm|MX|NV)?FP4(?:-\w+)*")
_SERVED_GGUF_RE = re.compile(r"^model\s*=\s*(\S+\.gguf)\s*$", re.M)


def served_gguf(serving):
    """The SERVED model filename from a serving recipe (main model line
    only — never model-draft, whose quant would mislabel the arm)."""
    m = _SERVED_GGUF_RE.search(serving or "")
    return m.group(1).rsplit("/", 1)[-1] if m else None


# Static exact-file registry (operator 2026-09-02: fill the quant·GiB·sha
# cells for arms whose serving text carries no attestation). Every value is
# an OBSERVED sha256sum of the real served file (cross-checked against the
# ini's pinned attestation where one exists, e.g. the 27B Q6). Ornith's file
# was not locatable in the expected paths at table-build time — stays
# unrendered rather than guessed.

def _file_sha8(served):
    """FILE_SHAS fallback keyed by the RESOLVED serving basename —
    dynamic arms have no static serving text for gguf_sha8 to scan, so
    the resolved file must be consulted directly (operator 2026-09-03:
    the Tiel row showed its size but no sha)."""
    base = (served or "").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    for frag, sha in FILE_SHAS.items():
        if base == frag or (frag in base):
            return sha[:8]
    return None


def gguf_sha8(serving):
    """First 8 hex of the served GGUF sha256, parsed from the serving
    registry OBSERVED attestation line ('; <64hex>'), falling back to the
    FILE_SHAS exact-file registry when the serving text names a known file.
    None when neither carries one. Display-only exact-file identifier
    (operator 2026-09-02: rendered in the quant cell)."""
    m = re.search(r";\s*([0-9a-f]{64})\b", serving or "")
    if m:
        return m.group(1)[:8]
    for frag, sha in FILE_SHAS.items():
        if frag in (serving or ""):
            return sha[:8]
    return None

# unsloth / ornith-ai = scout repo tracking. Cloud rows map by tag
# prefix to the API provider. Absent prefix = unverified — never
# guessed (rfp4 stays unprefixed until its oid is checked the same way).

def publisher_of(served, tag):
    """Publisher prefix for the model cell, or '' when unverified."""
    for pre, pub in GGUF_PUBLISHERS:
        if served and served.startswith(pre):
            return pub
    t = tag or ""
    if t.startswith("cloud-glm"):
        return "z.ai"
    if t.startswith("cloud-ds"):
        return "deepseek.ai"
    return ""


# --- quality-bucket rule (operator 2026-08-28, pinned): the three colors
# encode what the DATA can prove at the Wilson 95% floor/ceiling, mirroring
# the seq_stop/verdict style — never a vibe:
#   bold green  "Good Enough"     CI floor >= floor (provably at/above floor)
#   bold red    "Not Recommended" CI ceiling < ceiling (provably below floor)
#   bold orange remaining          between the lines (undecidable at this n —
#                                  the spec-008 honesty pattern).
# Thresholds load from config.toml [quality-buckets] — pinned calibration
# constants; changing them is a freeze-level decision. REACHABILITY: a
# perfect n/n arm bottoms at 1/(1+z^2/n) — at floor 0.80, arms with n <= 15
# cannot render green even at 100% (15/15 => 0.796); they render orange
# (undecidable-insufficient-n). Only pooled rows (n >= 17) reach green.
GOOD_ENOUGH_FLOOR = 0.80
NOT_RECOMMENDED_CEILING = 0.50
WALL_GOOD_MULT = 2.0   # green: within 2x the cohort's fastest arm
WALL_BAD_MULT = 6.0    # red: >= 6x the cohort's fastest (outlier signal)
# PINNED DECISION (operator 2026-08-28): wall-time NEVER weights the quality
# percentage. Wall stays a secondary sort criterion (tiebreak) and its own
# colored column + the CEI efficiency axis. Rationale: the verdict form is
# Pareto (quality, cost, wall) — a wall-weighted "quality" would collapse the
# Pareto into one scalar and declass entire hardware classes (wall is
# hardware-bound: the same recipe measured 1292s on the router vs 4459s on
# the laptop). Changing this = freeze-level decision.
WALL_WEIGHTS_QUALITY = False
# ABSOLUTE wall budget (operator decision 2026-08-28: "wall-time is human
# money" — the budget is a human-tolerance line, the SAME for every
# hardware class; it is a usability threshold, not a cross-class speed
# comparison, which stays forbidden). Configurable via GEFC_WALL_BUDGET_S.
# Coloring: over budget = YELLOW, > 2x over = RED — even for a 15/15 arm
# (quality proven, time impractical). Under budget = cohort-relative
# green/mid. Honest consequence on current data: the laptop Ornith suite
# (4459s) renders RED at the default — raise the env if laptop patience
# is decided higher; that is a config decision, not a hardware excuse.
# spec 044 FR-004: config.toml [wall] budget-s is the base value; the env
# beats it. 0 = calibration mode (V5, operator 2026-08-29): no wall limit,
# the panel renders raw walls with a calibration marker.
def _wall_budget(cfg_path, env_val):
    try:
        import configparser as _cp
        _cfgp = _cp.ConfigParser()
        _cfgp.read(cfg_path)
        base = float(_cfgp.get("wall", "budget-s", fallback="1800"))
    except (ValueError, OSError):
        base = 1800.0
    try:
        return float(env_val) if env_val is not None else base
    except ValueError:
        return base


WALL_BUDGET_S = _wall_budget(
    os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
                 "config.toml"),
    os.environ.get("GEFC_WALL_BUDGET_S"))


def wall_budget_for(hw_label):
    return WALL_BUDGET_S  # same human-money line for every class


def _bucket_from_bounds(lo, hi):
    if lo is None or hi is None:
        return "mid"
    if lo >= GOOD_ENOUGH_FLOOR:
        return "good"
    if hi < GOOD_ENOUGH_FLOOR:
        return "bad"
    return "mid"


def bucket_cells(arms):
    """Attach rg-* bucket classes to ok arms: quality/wall/recipe cells.
    Quality bucket from the Wilson bounds of the arm's score; wall bucket
    cohort-relative (per battery label — same battery, same item count);
    recipe bucket inherits the row's overall (quality) verdict."""
    cohorts = {}
    for a in arms:
        if a.get("status") == "ok":
            cohorts.setdefault(a.get("battery") or battery_of(a["tag"]), []).append(
                a.get("wall_s") or 0)
    for a in arms:
        if a.get("status") != "ok":
            continue
        score = a.get("with_retry") or a.get("bestof") or ""
        try:
            k, n = (int(x) for x in score.split("/"))
        except ValueError as e:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"bucket rule: malformed score {score!r} in row "
                f"{a.get('tag')!r} — fail loud, never guess") from e
        lo, hi = arms_summary.wilson(k, n) if n else (None, None)
        bucket = _bucket_from_bounds(lo, hi)
        a["bucket"] = bucket
        floor_pct = f"{GOOD_ENOUGH_FLOOR:.0%}"
        if bucket == "good":
            a["bucket_tip"] = (
                f"Good Enough: even the pessimistic (Wilson 95% floor) read "
                f"is at or above the {floor_pct} floor")
        elif lo is not None and hi is not None:
            a["bucket_tip"] = (
                f"Undecidable at this n: the 95% interval "
                f"({lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}) straddles the {floor_pct} floor")
        else:
            a["bucket_tip"] = "Undecidable at this n"
        wmin = min(cohorts.get(a.get("battery") or battery_of(a["tag"])) or [0])
        w = a.get("wall_s") or 0
        if wmin <= 0:
            a["wall_bucket"] = "mid"
        elif w <= WALL_GOOD_MULT * wmin:
            a["wall_bucket"] = "good"
        elif w >= WALL_BAD_MULT * wmin:
            a["wall_bucket"] = "bad"
        else:
            a["wall_bucket"] = "mid"
    return arms


def gen_of(label):
    """Battery generation: the max vN token in the label (v3 > v2 > v1).
    Superseded generations rank below and render dimmed — kept for
    history, never silently dropped (the archive discipline)."""
    import re as _re
    vs = _re.findall(r"v(\d+)", label or "")
    try:
        return max(int(v) for v in vs)
    except ValueError:
        return 1  # no parseable version token: treat as oldest generation


def battery_of(tag):
    """Which battery+version produced this arm — the homogeneity column
    (operator 2026-08-28: v1 rows must not read as comparable to v2/v3)."""
    if tag.endswith("-fcb15"):
        if tag.startswith("v3calib"):
            return "FCB-15 v3"
        if tag.startswith(("camp", "zflash", "zfull")):
            return "FCB-15 v2"
        return "FCB-15 v1"
    if tag.endswith("-traps"):
        if tag.startswith(("v2calib", "v2traddy", "recipe")):
            return "TRAPS-14 v2"
        return "TRAPS-14 v1"
    if tag.endswith("-cbi"):
        return "CBI-10"
    if tag.endswith("-sli"):
        return "SLI-10"
    if tag.endswith("-rsi"):
        return "RSI-4"
    return "FCB-15 v1"  # legacy arms tags carry no suffix


def artifact_battery(tag, data):
    """Artifact-first battery label (2026-08-31): rows record their own
    battery_version — prefer it over the static tag map, whose v1 fallback
    mislabeled any not-yet-enumerated dynamic prefix (e.g. flashnext-dswe)
    as gen-1 and dimmed the ranked row."""
    bv = next((str(r.get("battery_version")) for r in data
               if r.get("battery_version")), None)
    base = battery_of(tag)
    if bv and " v" in base:
        return base.rsplit(" v", 1)[0] + " v" + bv.lstrip("vV")
    return base

def _load_bench(rdir=None):
    """Pinned llama-bench registry (operator 2026-09-02): pair tag ->
    {pp, tg} from the p4096/n256/r2/-fa protocol. Absent = derived tg
    only, pp honest em-dash."""
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(rdir or "results", "bench.json")) as f:
            d = json.load(f)
        return d if isinstance(d, dict) else {}
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return {}


_BENCH = _load_bench()


def _load_tool_scores(db="data/benchmarks.sqlite"):
    """External tool-usage benchmark scores per served GGUF (operator
    2026-09-02): the BEST completed FULL-set tool-eval run (>=50
    scenarios) per model file, from the tool-eval store. Returns
    {gguf_basename: (n_scenarios, final_score, excluded, date)}.
    Full-set-only: the 15-scenario short and the 4-scenario fix-check
    are probes, not the column's score. Read-only sqlite, never
    crashes on a missing/locked db — absent = honest em-dash."""
    import sqlite3
    out = {}
    try:
        c = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{db}?mode=ro", uri=True)
        for _rid, created, cfg, sc in c.execute(
            "SELECT run_id, created_at, config_json, scores_json "
            "FROM scenario_runs WHERE run_type='tool_eval' "
            "AND status='completed'"):
            cfg = json.loads(cfg or "{}")
            sc = json.loads(sc or "{}")
            model = (cfg.get("model") or "").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            n = cfg.get("scenario_count") or 0
            fs = sc.get("final_score")
            if n < 50 or not model or fs is None:
                continue
            excl = sc.get("excluded_scenarios")
            excl_n = len(excl) if isinstance(excl, list) else (
                int(excl) if isinstance(excl, (int, float)) else 0)
            cur = out.get(model)
            # prefer the larger pack; tie-break on the higher score
            if cur is None or (n, fs) > (cur[0], cur[1]):
                out[model] = (n, float(fs), excl_n,
                              (created or "")[:10])
    except (OSError, ValueError, sqlite3.Error):
        return {}
    return out


_TOOL_SCORES = _load_tool_scores()


def _tool_norm(s):
    """Normalize a served-model name to the store's gguf-basename key
    shape: path-stripped, spaces->underscores, extension-free,
    case-folded (operator 2026-09-03: the full-round arms display
    'Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B AD-Q6_K-Q5_K' vs the stored basename with
    underscores + .gguf — the exact-name lookup missed measured runs)."""
    import re as _re
    base = (s or "").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    base = _re.sub(r"\.gguf$", "", base.strip())
    return _re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", base.lower())


def _tool_lookup(served):
    ts = _TOOL_SCORES.get(served or "")
    if ts:
        return ts
    n = _tool_norm(served)
    for k, v in _TOOL_SCORES.items():
        if _tool_norm(k) == n:
            return v
    return None


def _tool_cell(served):
    """Tool-benchmark score cell: the best full-set score for this
    served model, honest em-dash when no full run exists."""
    ts = _tool_lookup(served)
    return f"{ts[1]:.0f}" if ts else "—"


def _tool_tip(served):
    """Tooltip: pack size, infra-exclusions, date — a reduced-set score
    is not comparable to a clean one, so exclusions are surfaced."""
    ts = _tool_lookup(served)
    if not ts:
        return "no full-set tool-eval run for this arm yet"
    n, fs, excl, d = ts
    tail = f", {excl} infra-excluded" if excl else ""
    return (f"tool-eval {n:.0f} scenarios{tail}: {fs:.0f}/100"
            + (f", run {d}" if d else ""))

def _speed_color(kind, v):
    """pp/tg verdict color (operator 2026-09-02): green above the green
    cut, red below the red cut, yellow between (the wall column's rg-mid
    yellow #e0a83f, operator 2026-09-02). tg: 50/10, pp: 500/100."""
    hi, lo = (50, 10) if kind == "tg" else (500, 100)
    if v is None:
        return None
    return "#2e7d32" if v > hi else ("#c62828" if v < lo else "#e0a83f")


def _fmt_pptg(v, ctx=None):
    """tg / pp cell (operator 2026-09-02): one compact flow, tg first
    (decode is the everyday number). The pp after the slash is the
    common-usage 4k fill — tagged inline '@4k' when benched — followed by
    the other fills in relevance order: '@512' (max pp) then '@256k'
    (min pp); absent slots are simply not shown (honest, never derived).
    Colors: tg green above 50 / red below 10; pp green above 500 / red
    below 100; yellow between (the wall yellow). The first number stays
    first so the sort's parseFloat keeps ranking on tg."""
    if not v:
        return "—"
    pp, tg = v

    def _s(kind, val):
        if val is None:
            return "—"
        c = _speed_color(kind, val)
        return f"<span style='color:{c}'>{val}</span>"

    head = f"{_s('tg', tg)} / {_s('pp', pp)}"
    c4 = (ctx or {}).get("4096")
    if c4 is not None and pp is not None:
        try:
            same = abs(float(pp) - float(c4)) < 0.05
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            same = False  # malformed registry entry: no @4k tag, no crash
        if same:
            # the headline pp IS the 4k fill — tag it, do not repeat it
            head += " <span class='dim'>@4k</span>"
    extra = []
    for lbl, n in (("@512", "512"), ("@256k", "262144")):
        x = (ctx or {}).get(n)
        if x is not None:
            extra.append(f"{_s('pp', x)} <span class='dim'>{lbl}</span>")
    if extra:
        head += " · " + " · ".join(extra)
    return head


def wall_bucket_tip(a, cohort_min):
    """Hover text for the wall cell: cohort-relative verdict + the class
    budget/spare headroom (spare budget is spendable on retries/best-of
    passes — conversions are MEASURED by budgeted runs, never assumed)."""
    lbl = a.get("battery") or battery_of(a["tag"])
    wmin = cohort_min.get(lbl) or 0
    w = a.get("wall_s") or 0
    bucket = a.get("wall_bucket", "mid")
    hw = a.get("hw") or ""
    budget = wall_budget_for(hw)
    spare = budget - w
    head = (f"wall {w:.0f}s of the {budget:.0f}s class budget "
            f"({spare:+.0f}s spare headroom)")
    if not wmin:
        return head + " — no cohort baseline yet"
    ratio = w / wmin
    if bucket == "good":
        return (head + f"; within {WALL_GOOD_MULT:.0f}x of the cohort's "
                f"fastest arm ({wmin:.0f}s)")
    if bucket == "bad":
        return (head + f"; OUTLIER {ratio:.1f}x the cohort's fastest arm "
                f"({wmin:.0f}s) — check serving/endpoint before reading quality")
    return head + f"; {ratio:.1f}x the cohort's fastest arm ({wmin:.0f}s)"

                   "compare only within the same battery version")

# --- recipe memory registry (operator 2026-09-04) -------------------------
# VRAM/RAM per recipe @64k ctx, quick load/unload on the .15 test box:
# VRAM = GTT sysfs delta (APU-unified memory class), RAM = host VmRSS.
# Rows are MEASUREMENTS in results/recipe-memory.jsonl (host+date+method
# stamped per row). Arms map to rows by tag prefix; None = weights not on
# disk anymore — an honest gap, never a guessed number.
_MEM_ROWS = {}
_MEM_LOADED = False


def _load_recipe_memory(rdir=None):
    global _MEM_LOADED, _MEM_ROWS
    if _MEM_LOADED:
        return
    _MEM_LOADED = True
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(rdir or "results", "recipe-memory.jsonl")) as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                try:
                    r = json.loads(line)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if r.get("recipe"):
                    _MEM_ROWS[r["recipe"]] = r
    except OSError:
        pass


_TAG_MEMKEY = (
    # longest-prefix first; None = weights absent from the cluster
    ("flashnext-rfp4", None),
    ("flashnext-udq4", None),
    ("flashnext-", "flashnext-m64"),
    ("ymq-", "ymq-xl"),
    ("cfgain-", "cfgain-q6"),
    ("turboneo-", "turboneo-q6"),
    ("tiel-q4", "tiel-q4"),
    ("tiel-q5", "tiel-q5"),
    ("tiel-q6", "tiel-q6"),
    ("tiel-q8", "tiel-q8"),
    ("qwen36-bf16", "qwen36-bf16"),
    ("qwen36-q6", "qwen36-q6"),
    ("qwen36-q8", "qwen36-q8"),
    ("q27b-q6-dot15", "q38-27b-q6"),
    ("q3827b-", "q38-27b-q6"),
    ("smoke-ornith", "ornith-q65"),
    ("ornith", "ornith-q65"),
)


def mem_of(tag, rdir=None):
    """The measured memory row for an arm tag, or None."""
    _load_recipe_memory(rdir)
    t = (tag or "").lower()
    for pfx, key in _TAG_MEMKEY:
        if t.startswith(pfx):
            return _MEM_ROWS.get(key) if key else None
    return None


# --- GE graduation badges (spec 052) ---------------------------------------
# Verdicts are re-derived from the artifacts on EVERY build via the 051
# engine (scripts/ge_ladder.py); nothing persisted — a demoting session
# shows on the next refresh. The panel renders; it never second-guesses
# a verdict.
_GE_CACHE = {}


def _ge_module():
    import importlib.util
    p = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                     "ge_ladder.py")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ge_ladder", p)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot load ge_ladder from {p}")
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def ge_badges(rdir):
    """(pair, agent, agents_md) -> verdict dict via the 051 engine,
    including the D8 relation (agentic rows vs the contemporaneous base
    pair wall). One computation per build; {} on an empty results dir."""
    key = os.path.abspath(rdir or "results")
    if key in _GE_CACHE:
        return _GE_CACHE[key]
    out = {}
    try:
        gl = _ge_module()
        root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
        ge, wallcfg = gl.load_config(root)
        try:
            budget = int(wallcfg.get("budget-s", 0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            budget = 0
        tags, _ = gl.load_rows([rdir or "results"])
        pairs = gl.build_pairs(tags)
        for pair in sorted(pairs):
            for agent in sorted({(r.get("agent") or "none")
                                 for bat in pairs[pair].values() for r in bat}):
                for amd in sorted({(r.get("agents_md") or "")
                                   for bat in pairs[pair].values() for r in bat}):
                    v = gl.combination_verdict(
                        pair, pairs[pair], ge, budget,
                        None if agent == "none" else agent, amd or None)
                    if v:
                        out[(pair, agent, amd)] = v
        base_wall = {}
        for (pair, agent, amd), v in out.items():
            if agent == "none":
                base_wall.setdefault((pair, amd), v["pair_wall"])
        for k2, v in out.items():
            if k2[1] != "none":
                bw = base_wall.get((k2[0], k2[2]))
                if bw and v["pair_wall"] > 2 * bw:
                    v["verdict"] = "— (inefficient, D8)"
    except Exception as exc:  # engine fault must not kill the panel build
        import sys
        sys.stderr.write(f"ge_badges: engine degraded ({exc!r}) "
                         "— no badges this build\n")
        out = {}
    _GE_CACHE[key] = out
    return out


def _ge_badge_span(v, compact=False):
    """One GE badge; compact form for ranking rows (FR-002), full text
    for the Arms table (FR-001). Tooltip always carries the gates."""
    txt = v.get("verdict") or "—"
    short = ("GE\u2713" if txt.startswith("GE\u2713") else
             "GE?" if txt.startswith("GE?") else "—")
    col = ("#2e7d32" if short.startswith("GE\u2713") else
           "#e0a83f" if short == "GE?" else None)
    cls = "ge-badge" if col else "ge-badge dim"
    style = f" style='color:{col}'" if col else ""
    from html import escape as _esc
    g = v.get("gates") or {}
    tip = _esc(f"{txt} — G1 {g.get('G1', '—')} · G2 {g.get('G2', '—')} · "
               f"G5 {g.get('G5', '—')} · pooled {v.get('pooled', '—')}")
    body = _esc(short if compact else txt)
    return f"<span class='{cls}'{style} title='{tip}'>{body}</span>"


def _ge_arms_cell(a, rdir):
    """The Arms-table GE cell (FR-001): verdict text or the dim dash."""
    v = ge_badges(rdir).get((_prp_pair_key(a.get("tag") or ""),
                             a.get("agent") or "none",
                             a.get("agents_md") or ""))
    if v is None:
        return "<td class='nm'>—</td>"
    return f"<td>{_ge_badge_span(v, compact=False)}</td>"


def _ge_ladder_legend():
    """FR-004: the ladder line, floors read from the sealed config —
    never hardcoded (SC-003)."""
    try:
        gl = _ge_module()
        root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
        ge, _ = gl.load_config(root)
        fp = float(ge.get("floor-provisional", 0.0))
        fs = float(ge.get("floor-sealed", 0.0))
        sr = int(ge.get("sessions-required", 2))
    except Exception:
        return ""
    return (f"<p class='dim' style='margin:6px 0 0'>GE ladder (sealed): "
            f"GE? provisional = one session at the {fp:.2f} Wilson floor · "
            f"GE\u2713 sealed = two sessions pooled at the {fs:.2f} floor · "
            f"trap discipline pooled · verdicts recomputed from artifacts "
            f"on every build (demotable on a bad session) — a badge is "
            f"evidence, not a recommendation: D9's fastest-GE pick may "
            f"disagree. (config: sessions-required={sr})</p>")

def _gguf_sizes():
    """Cluster-wide gguf inventory (operator 2026-08-28): gguf files and
    models.ini sync across the HA pair (strix2 <-> halo2/.15), so a size
    shown for a served gguf may come from EITHER member. Traddy is not a
    gguf-cluster member for the 27B (policy: the dense 27B is unusable
    there — cell D measured 1.63 t/s < 2.0 gate — and its 27B weights were
    wiped 2026-08-28); it is intentionally not inventoried."""
    import glob as _g
    import os as _os
    import subprocess as _sp
    sizes = {}
    patterns = [
        _os.path.expanduser("~/Downloads/LLM/**/*.gguf"),
        _os.path.expanduser(
            "~/Piero/Work/Qwen-3.8-27B_Strix-Halo_gfx1151/models/*.gguf"),
    ]
    import re as _re
    shard = _re.compile(r"-(\d+)-of-(\d+)\.gguf$")

    def _add(acc: dict, name: str, nbytes: int) -> None:
        """Sharded models sum into ONE footprint under the shard stem —
        within ONE source; non-sharded duplicate COPIES (same file on
        Downloads and the router's models dir, or on both HA members)
        take the MAX, never the sum — 2026-09-02: the 27B Q6 rendered
        47.2 GiB = two 23.5 copies accumulated. Files under 100 MiB are
        download stubs (the curl/xet trap) and never enter."""
        if nbytes < 100 * 2**20:
            return
        stem = shard.sub("", name)
        gib = round(nbytes / 2**30, 1)
        if shard.search(name):
            acc[stem] = round(acc.get(stem, 0.0) + gib, 1)
        else:
            acc[stem] = max(acc.get(stem, 0.0), gib)

    local: dict = {}
    for pat in patterns:
        for p in _g.glob(pat, recursive=True):
            try:
                _add(local, _os.path.basename(p), _os.path.getsize(p))
            except OSError:
                pass
    sizes.update(local)
    # HA peer (halo2/.15): same synced models tree, ssh file inventory
    try:
        out = _sp.run(
            ["ssh", "-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=5",
             "piero@192.168.50.15",
             "find ~/Qwen-3.8-27B_Strix-Halo_gfx1151/models -maxdepth 1 "
             "-name '*.gguf' -printf '%f %s\n'; "
             "find ~/Downloads/LLM/Qwen38 -name '*.gguf' -printf '%f %s\n'"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
        peer: dict = {}
        for ln in out.stdout.splitlines():
            name, _, sz = ln.rpartition(" ")
            if name and sz.isdigit():
                _add(peer, name, int(sz))
        # the cluster holds COPIES of the same weights — one footprint per
        # model, never the sum across members
        for k, v in peer.items():
            sizes.setdefault(k, v)
    except (_sp.TimeoutExpired, OSError):
        print("panel_build: HA peer inventory unavailable — sizes local-only")
    return sizes


_GGUF_SIZES = None  # lazy: built on first size_of call
_FLEET_ALIAS_GGUF = None


def _fleet_alias_gguf():
    """Section name -> served gguf basename, parsed from the
    cluster-synced fleet models.ini (the source of truth for what a recipe
    actually serves). Same model + recipe => same file => one quant label
    and one size everywhere in the table."""
    global _FLEET_ALIAS_GGUF
    if _FLEET_ALIAS_GGUF is None:
        path = _os_path_expanduser(
            "~/Piero/Work/Qwen-3.8-27B_Strix-Halo_gfx1151/models/models.ini")
        m = {}
        sec = None
        try:
            with open(path) as f:
                for ln in f:
                    ln = ln.strip()
                    if ln.startswith("[") and ln.endswith("]"):
                        sec = ln[1:-1]
                    elif "=" in ln and sec:
                        k, v = ln.split("=", 1)
                        if k.strip() == "model" and v.strip().endswith(".gguf"):
                            m[sec] = os.path.basename(v.strip())
        except OSError:
            pass
        _FLEET_ALIAS_GGUF = m
    return _FLEET_ALIAS_GGUF


def _os_path_expanduser(p):
    import os as _o
    return _o.path.expanduser(p)


def size_of(model):
    global _GGUF_SIZES
    if not (model or "").endswith(".gguf"):
        return "—"
    if _GGUF_SIZES is None:
        _GGUF_SIZES = _gguf_sizes()
    name = model.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    # shard files resolve to their model's summed footprint (the stem key)
    stem = _re_sub_shard(name)
    n = _GGUF_SIZES.get(name, _GGUF_SIZES.get(stem))
    return f"{n}" if n is not None else "—"


def _re_sub_shard(name):
    import re as _re
    return _re.sub(r"-(\d+)-of-(\d+)\.gguf$", "", name)
