         "against, and the closest to the factory master of anything we "
         "hold (96.53% top-1, KLD 0.0061 — quant noise is now measured "
         "to be negligible next to finetune drift).",
         "Larger than the sealed Q6 for no serving gain."),
        ("Qwen3.8-27B router set",
         "The daily driver: speculative decoding gives it about 3x its "
         "plain decode speed. Serves strixy2's interactive sessions — "
         "and the overnight audit proved every request rides the default "
         "funnel.",
         "Its battery row is still incomplete (needs one spec-served "
         "re-run); the density makes it the weakest big-model reasoner."),
        ("Ornith-1.5 (a Qwen3.6 derivative)",
         "A derived model that nearly matches its base at higher speed — "
         "theta 2.47, tool 86, 56 t/s.",
         "The derivative penalty is now measured, not assumed: 0.256 "
         "KLD against the same factory master its root quantizes to "
         "(35x the Q6's drift). Upstream changes inherit."),
        ("The two BF16 factory masters",
         "The originals every quant descends from — Qwen3.6-35B (65 GiB) "
         "and Qwen3.8-27B (51 GiB), both measured here; every family "
         "KLD number on this panel is computed against them.",
         "Storage-heavy (~116 GiB) with no serving role; kept as the "
         "measurement root. NOT runnable here: the Flash-Next BF16 "
         "(~355 GiB) does not fit a 124 GiB box — that family's "
         "fidelity stays REPORTED (unsloth ladder), never locally "
         "measured."),
    )
    rows = []
    for i, (title, plus, minus) in enumerate(cards, 1):
        rows.append(
            f"<div style='margin:6px 0'><b>{i}. {title}</b><br>"
            f"<span class='dim'>&#x2705; {plus}</span><br>"
            f"<span class='dim'>&#x26a0;&#xfe0f; {minus}</span></div>")
    storage = (
        "<div style='margin:8px 0 2px'><b>Storage position 2026-09-04</b> "
        "— 09-03 pass freed ~635 GiB; 09-04 freed .15's measured udq4/"
         "rocmfp4 quants (194 GiB, appliance untouched). INCIDENT (agent "
         "error, 09-04): the laptop's flash-next weights (183 GiB) were "
         "deleted on a false 'staging duplicate' premise — ~/Downloads "
         "symlinks onto the same filesystem made one copy read as two; "
         "the 3.84bpw try-out is re-staging now, the M64 twin deferred. "
         "Seed-Coder is gone fleet-wide (8B floor void). Default "
         "serving switched to Tiel-q6. Full record: "
        "<a href='MODEL-RETENTION-20260904.md' target='_blank'>"
        "docs/MODEL-RETENTION-20260904.md</a>.</div>")
    try:
        _upd = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%cd", "--date=format:%y%m%d %H:%M",
             "--", "docs/MODEL-RETENTION-20260904.md"],
            cwd=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/..",
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20).stdout.strip()
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        _upd = ""
    _upd_sfx = f" <span class='dim'>(updated {_upd})</span>" if _upd else ""
    return ("<section><details id='exec-sec' class='qr-collapse'>"
            "<summary class='label' style='cursor:pointer;user-select:none' "
            "title='What this is: the plain-language keep/delete verdicts "
            "per model, with the storage position. The full decision "
            "record lives in the retention doc.'>Executive summary"
            + _upd_sfx + "</summary>"
            "<div class=\"panel\" style=\"font-size:12.5px;padding:8px "
            "12px\">"
            + "".join(rows) + storage + "</div></details></section>")



def _quadrant_html():
    """Quality vs speed quadrant (operator 2026-09-03 prototype): a
    Gartner-style scatter — y = battery quality %, x = the speed
    composite (tg*10 + pp@4k), colored by hardware class (orange = Strix
    Halo measured, green = VRAM-poor-compatible-usable when such arms
    exist), dot fill = tool-benchmark status (green ok, red failed,
    gray not run), ring = hardware class, numbered dots below.
    Degrades to an empty string when the bench leg never ran (spec 052
    SC-004: the panel builds pristine on an empty results dir)."""
    _q = _quadrant_data()
    if _q is None:
        return ""
    return _q


def _quadrant_data():
    import json as _json
    import os as _os
    # measured arms: (label, quality %, tg, pp@4k, tool, green?)
    # sourced from the registries — same numbers as the tables
    def _k_n(tag):
        try:
            rows = [_json.loads(ln) for ln in
                    open(f"{_os.path.join(_os.path.dirname(__file__), '..')}/"
                         f"results/fcb15-{tag}.jsonl") if ln.strip()]
        except OSError:
            return None
        items = {}
        for r in rows:
            items.setdefault(r["item"], {})[r.get("phase", "greedy")] = r
        if not items:
            return None
        return (sum(1 for p in items.values()
                    if any(x.get("ok") for x in p.values())), len(items))
    try:
        with open(_os.path.join(_os.path.dirname(__file__), "..",
                                "results/bench.json")) as _bf:
            b = _json.load(_bf)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        # bench leg not run = not measured, never a crash (spec 052
        # SC-004: an empty results dir builds a pristine panel, exit 0)
        return None
    except ValueError as _e:
        raise SystemExit(f"quadrant: CORRUPT results/bench.json: {_e}") from _e
    except OSError as _e:
        raise SystemExit(f"quadrant: cannot read results/bench.json: {_e}") from _e
    arms = [
        ("qwen36-q6", "qwen36-q6", "qwen36-q6", 91, True, "round"),
        ("flashnext-dswe", "flashnext-dswe", "flashnext-dswe", 85, False, "round"),
        ("qwen36-q8", "qwen36-q8", "qwen36-q8", 88, True, "round"),
        ("ornith-ad", "ornith", "ornith-ad", 86, True, "round"),
        ("tiel-q6", "tiel-q6", "tiel-q6", 89, True, "round"),
        ("tiel-q8", "tiel-q8", "tiel-q8", None, True, "round"),
        ("q27b-q6-dot15", "q27b-q6-dot15", "q27b-q6-dot15", None, False, "round"),
        # VRAM-poor measurements land here with shape "square" (traddy)
    ]
    # typed: (label, quality_frac, speed_composite, tool_score, green)
    pts: list[tuple[str, float, float, int | None, bool, str]] = []
    for label, tag, bkey, tool, green, shape in arms:
        tr = _k_n(tag + "-traps")
        fc = _k_n(tag + "-fcb15")
        q = None
        if tr and fc:
            q = (tr[0] + fc[0]) / (tr[1] + fc[1]) * 100.0
        elif tr:
            q = tr[0] / tr[1] * 100.0  # partial: label honestly
            label += " (traps only)"
        be = b.get(bkey, {})
        tg, pp = be.get("tg"), be.get("pp")
        if q is None or tg is None or pp is None:
            continue
        pts.append((label, q, tg * 10 + pp, tool, green, shape))
    if not pts:
        return ""
    # plot geometry
    W, H = 780, 430
    ml, mr, mt, mb = 60, 20, 30, 60
    pw, ph = W - ml - mr, H - mt - mb
    xs = [p[2] for p in pts]  # speed composite
    x0, x1 = 300, max(1750, max(xs) + 60)
    y0, y1 = 80, 100
    def px(x): return ml + (x - x0) / (x1 - x0) * pw
    def py(y): return mt + (y1 - y) / (y1 - y0) * ph
    circles = []
    # collision stagger (operator 2026-09-03): dots whose centers sit
    # within ~2.6 dot-radii get nudged apart vertically so every number
    # stays legible; the true values ride the tooltip + legend
    placed = []
    for (label, q, speed, _tool, _green, _shape) in pts:
        cx, cy = px(speed), py(q)
        for (ox, oy, _) in placed:
            if (cx - ox) ** 2 + (cy - oy) ** 2 < 30 * 30:
                cy = max(cy, oy + 28)
        placed.append((cx, cy, label))
    for i, ((_label, _q, _speed, tool, green, shape), (cx, cy, _)) in enumerate(
            zip(pts, placed, strict=True), 1):
        fill = ("#2e7d32" if (tool is not None and tool >= 85) else
                ("#c62828" if (tool is not None and tool < 60) else "#5a6070"))
        ring = "#9aa0ac" if green else "#e08a2e"
        # no tooltip (operator 2026-09-03: the number links to the legend;
        # one source of truth). Shape: round = Strix Halo measured,
        # square = VRAM-poor (traddy) measured.
        if shape == "square":
            markers = (f'<rect x="{cx - 11:.0f}" y="{cy - 11:.0f}" width="22" '
                       f'height="22" rx="3" fill="{fill}" stroke="{ring}" '
                       f'stroke-width="3" opacity=".95"/>')
        else:
            markers = (f'<circle cx="{cx:.0f}" cy="{cy:.0f}" r="13" '
                       f'fill="{fill}" stroke="{ring}" stroke-width="3" '
                       f'opacity=".95"/>')
        letter = chr(ord("A") + i - 1)  # A, B, C ... (operator 2026-09-03:
        # letters on the chart so they cannot clash with the numbered
        # Executive summary cards)
        circles.append(
            markers
            + f'<text x="{cx:.0f}" y="{cy + 4:.0f}" text-anchor="middle" '
            f'font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff">{letter}</text>')
    grid = ""
    for gx in (500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500):
        grid += (f'<line x1="{px(gx):.0f}" y1="{mt}" x2="{px(gx):.0f}" '
                 f'y2="{mt + ph}" stroke="#3a3f4b" stroke-width="1"/>'
                 f'<text x="{px(gx):.0f}" y="{H - 40}" text-anchor="middle" '
                 f'font-size="11" fill="#8a93a6">{gx}</text>')
    for gy in (85, 90, 95, 100):
        grid += (f'<line x1="{ml}" y1="{py(gy):.0f}" x2="{W - mr}" '
                 f'y2="{py(gy):.0f}" stroke="#3a3f4b" stroke-width="1"/>'
                 f'<text x="{ml - 8}" y="{py(gy) + 4:.0f}" text-anchor="end" '
                 f'font-size="11" fill="#8a93a6">{gy}%</text>')
    legend = []
    green = None
    shape = "round"
    for i, (label, q, speed, tool, _green, _shape) in enumerate(pts, 1):
        tool_txt = f"tool ok ({tool})" if (tool is not None and tool >= 85) else (
            f"tool ko ({tool})" if (tool is not None and tool < 60) else "tool not run")
        letter = chr(ord("A") + i - 1)
        legend.append(
            f"<div style='margin:3px 0'><b>{letter}.</b> "
            f"<span style='color:{'#9aa0ac' if green else '#e08a2e'}'>"
            f"{label}</span> — quality {q:.1f}%, "
            f"speed composite {speed:.0f} "
            f"(tg {speed/10:.1f} + pp), "
            f"{tool_txt}.</div>")
    return (
        "<section><div class='label'>Quality vs Speed vs Hardware class</div>"
        "<div class='panel'><svg viewBox='0 0 " + str(W) + " " + str(H) +
        "' width='100%' style='max-width:820px' role='img' "
        "aria-label='quality vs speed quadrant'>"
        + grid + "".join(circles) +
        "<text x='" + str((ml + W - mr) / 2) + "' y='18' text-anchor='middle' "
        "font-size='15' fill='#d7dce6'>GEFC — Good Enough for Coding</text>"
        "<text x='14' y='" + str(mt + ph / 2) + "' transform='rotate(-90 14 "
        + str(mt + ph / 2) + ")' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' "
        "fill='#d7dce6'>quality</text>"
        "<text x='" + str((ml + W - mr) / 2) + "' y='" + str(H - 22) +
        "' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12' fill='#d7dce6'>speed "
        "composite (tg*10 + pp@4k)</text>"
        "</svg>"

        "<div style='margin-top:6px'><b>Legend:</b> point shape: "
        "round = Strix Halo measured, square = VRAM-poor (traddy) "
        "measured. Ring = hardware "
        "class: <span style='color:#e08a2e'>&#9679;</span> VRAM and/or "
        "RAM hungry, <span style='color:#9aa0ac'>&#9679;</span> "
        "May be compatible and usable enough on 8GB+ VRAM boxes. "
        "Fill = tool benchmark: "
        "<span style='color:#2e7d32'>&#9679;</span> ok (full run, &ge;85), "
        "<span style='color:#c62828'>&#9679;</span> failed, "
        "<span style='color:#5a6070'>&#9679;</span> not run. Number = the "
        "recipe in the legend below.</div>"
        + "".join(legend) + "</div></section>")


def _tech_summary_html(merged, doc, rdir, partial_pairs=None):
    _ladder_line = _ge_ladder_legend()
    """Technical summary (operator 2026-09-03): one compact row per arm,
    every cell colored except Model. Columns: Model (publisher+model+
    GiB+sha) | PRP+KLD vs BF16 | TRAPS+FCB+GBench pass/test | Quality
    (thetap + fixed-batt%) | Tools | Speed (tg, pp@512/@4k/@64k, server)
    | Last update."""
    from html import escape as _esc

    def _share_color(s):
        return ("#2e7d32" if s >= 0.9 else
                ("#c62828" if s < 0.7 else "#e0a83f"))

    def _elem_color(k, n):
        """Per-element battery color (operator 2026-09-04): the FCB rule
        (green >13/15, red <11/15, else yellow) generalized by share to
        TR (14) and GB (30)."""
        if not n:
            return "#8a93a6"
        s = k / n
        return ("#2e7d32" if s > 13 / 15 else
                ("#c62828" if s < 11 / 15 else "#e0a83f"))

    def _theta_color(v):
        """θp 3-level color — cluster-gap cuts in the measured landscape
        (0.65 → 1.56 → 2.13 → 2.47; operator 2026-09-04)."""
        return ("#2e7d32" if v >= 2.5 else
                ("#c62828" if v < 1.0 else "#e0a83f"))

    _PHASES = ("F", "T", "G", "P", "K", "W")

    def _phase_seq(done, tag, doc):
        """Full fixed phase sequence, state-colored (operator
        2026-09-04): green = done (tooltip = leg date), yellow = in
        progress (live banner, F/T legs only), red = not measured."""
        _ongoing = set()
        for _r in (doc.get("now_running") or []):
            _rt = _r.get("tag") or ""
            _leg = str(_r.get("leg") or "")
            if _rt and (_rt == tag or _rt.startswith(
                    f"{_prp_pair_key(tag)}-")):
                _ongoing.add("F" if "fcb" in _leg else
                             ("T" if "trap" in _leg else ""))
        _spans = []
        for _l in _PHASES:
            if _l in done:
                _d = done[_l]
                _c = "#2e7d32"
                _t = f"phase {_l} done{_d and ' ' + _d or ''}"
            elif _l in _ongoing:
                _c, _t = "#e0a83f", f"phase {_l} in progress"
            else:
                _c, _t = "#c62828", f"phase {_l} not measured"
            _spans.append(
                f"<span style='color:{_c}' title='{_t}'>{_l}</span>")
        return "<span class='dim'>" + "".join(_spans) + "</span>"

    def _tool_color(v):
        return ("#2e7d32" if v >= 90 else
                ("#c62828" if v < 60 else "#e0a83f"))

    rows = []
    for a in merged:
        tag = a.get("tag") or ""
        key = _prp_pair_key(tag)
        served = served_gguf(SERVING_RECIPES.get(tag, ""))
        if not served:
            _m2 = re.search(r"([\w./-]+\.gguf)", a.get("recipe") or "")
            served = _m2.group(1).rsplit("/", 1)[-1] if _m2 else (
                a.get("model") or "")
        _pub = publisher_of(served, tag)
        _sha8 = gguf_sha8(SERVING_RECIPES.get(tag, "")) or _file_sha8(served)
        size = size_of(served)
        model_cell = ((f"<span class='dim'>{_pub} / </span>" if _pub else "")
                     + _esc((a.get("model") or "—").rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
                     + (f" <span class='dim'>· {_esc(size)} · {_sha8}</span>"
                        if size != "—" else ""))
        _gev = ge_badges(rdir).get((_prp_pair_key(a.get("tag") or ""),
                                    a.get("agent") or "none",
                                    a.get("agents_md") or ""))
        if _gev is not None:
            # FR-002: compact badge on the ranking row, full verdict in
            # the tooltip; display only — sort stays quality-then-wall
            model_cell += " " + _ge_badge_span(_gev, compact=True)
        prp_cell = _prp_cell(a, doc)
        tr = a.get("traps_score") or ""
        fc, fc_tip = _merit_fc(a)
        gb = gb_progress(rdir, key) or ""
        gb_m = re.match(r"GB (\d+)/(\d+)", gb)
        parts, shares = [], []
        def _frac(m):
            """(k, n) ints from a regex match, None on any parse fault —
            a malformed score string degrades to skipping that battery,
            never crashes the summary."""
            try:
                k, n = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
                return (k / n, f"{k}/{n}") if n > 0 else None
            except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, TypeError):
                return None

        for lbl, val in (("TR", tr), ("FCB", fc)):
            m = re.match(r"(\d+)/(\d+)", str(val))
            fr = _frac(m) if m else None
            if fr:
                shares.append(fr[0])  # feeds the column's JS sort value
                try:
                    _ek, _en = (int(x) for x in fr[1].split("/"))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    _ek, _en = 0, 0  # degrade to gray, never crash
                _c = _elem_color(_ek, _en)
                parts.append(
                    f"<span style='color:{_c}' title='{fc_tip}'>"
                    f"{lbl} {fr[1]}</span>"
                    if lbl == "FCB" and fc_tip
                    else f"<span style='color:{_c}'>{lbl} {fr[1]}</span>")
        fr = _frac(gb_m) if gb_m else None
        if fr:
            shares.append(fr[0])  # feeds the column's JS sort value
            try:
                _ek, _en = (int(x) for x in fr[1].split("/"))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                _ek, _en = 0, 0  # degrade to gray, never crash
            parts.append(
                f"<span style='color:{_elem_color(_ek, _en)}'>GB {fr[1]}</span>")
        bat_cell = " · ".join(parts) if parts else "—"
        _cuts_t = _budget_cut_items(a.get("merge"), rdir)
        if _cuts_t:
            bat_cell += (" <span class='dim' title='items lost whole to "
                         "token-budget truncation: every attempt at "
                         "finish=length with zero content — a budget "
                         "death, not a wrong answer'>· budget-cut: "
                         + ",".join(str(i) for i in _cuts_t) + "</span>")
        # attempts profile absorbed from the retired ranking table
        # (operator 2026-09-04): solved@1st/2nd/3rd/4th attempt
        _att = a.get("attempts_profile")
        if _att:
            bat_cell += (f" <span class='dim' title='solved@1st/2nd/3rd/"
                         f"4th attempt — the retry ladder profile'>"
                         f"· @{_att}</span>")
        n, k = a.get("n") or 0, a.get("k") or 0
        qbits = []
        pct = (100.0 * k / n) if n else None
        # GBench quality LEADS the cell (operator 2026-09-03): θp first,
        # the fixed-battery percentage second. The gbench report is keyed
        # by the RAW pair (ornith) — NOT the PRP-registry key
        # (ornith-ad) that _prp_pair_key returns (bug 2026-09-03: the
        # aliased lookup missed every report and rows lost their θp).
        _gbt = re.sub(r"-(fcb15|traps)$", "", tag or "")
        tp = None
        _tp_ceil = False
        _tse = None
        _lp_bit = ""   # spec 060 US-4: the logic/planning axis on the row
        _gr: dict = {}
        try:
            _gr = json.load(open(os.path.join(
                rdir or "results", f"gbench-{_gbt}.report.json")))
            _pa_f = ((_gr.get("families") or {}).get("private_api") or {})
            tp = _pa_f.get("theta")
            _tp_ceil = "exceeded" in str(_pa_f.get("span") or "")
            if tp is None:
                tp = _gr.get("theta")
                _tse = _gr.get("se")
            else:
                _se_v = _pa_f.get("se")
                _tse = float(_se_v) if _se_v is not None else None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            tp = None
        # spec 060 US-4: θlp from the report's axes block (same file the
        # θp bit reads); absent -> no bit (an honest gap, never a guess)
        try:
            _ax = (_gr.get("axes") or {}).get("logic_planning") or {}
            _lp = _ax.get("theta")
            if _lp is not None:
                _fam_bits = ", ".join(
                    f"{fn} {(_gr.get('families') or {}).get(fn, {}).get('theta')}"
                    for fn in ("zebra", "sat", "blocksworld")
                    if fn in (_gr.get("families") or {}))
                _gate = (_gr.get("ge_gate") or {}).get("state", "—")
                _c = ("#2e7d32" if _lp >= 0.0 else
                      ("#e0a83f" if _lp >= -1.5 else "#c62828"))
                _fams_txt = _fam_bits or "not measured"
                _tip = ("theta_lp = logic/planning axis theta (spec 060: "
                        "zebra+sat+blocksworld pooled). Coloring: green "
                        ">= 0 / yellow -1.5..0 / red < -1.5. Families: "
                        + _fams_txt + ". GE gate: " + str(_gate))
                _lp_bit = (f"<span style='color:{_c}' title='{_tip}'>"
                           f"θlp {_lp:.2f}</span> ")
        except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
            _lp_bit = ""
        if tp is None:
            # doc-level theta (spec 044 surface ported from the retired
            # ranking table): report file absent -> the arms-doc entry
            _th2 = ((doc.get("gbench_theta") or {}).get(tag)
                    or (doc.get("gbench_theta") or {})
                    .get(a.get("pair_key") or ""))
            if _th2:
                tp = _th2.get("theta")
                _tp_ceil = "exceeded" in str(_th2.get("span") or "")
                _se_v = _th2.get("se")
                try:
                    _tse = float(_se_v) if _se_v is not None else None
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    _tse = None
        if _lp_bit:
            qbits.append(_lp_bit)
        if tp is not None:
            try:
                _tv = float(tp)
                _ci = ""
                if _tse is not None:
                    try:
                        _ci = (f" ({max(_tv - 1.96 * _tse, -9.99):.2f}–"
                               f"{min(_tv + 1.96 * _tse, 9.99):.2f})")
                    except (TypeError, ValueError):
                        _ci = ""
                qbits.append(
                    f"<span style='color:{_theta_color(_tv)}' "
                    "title='θp coloring: green ≥2.5 · yellow 1.0–2.5 · "
                    "red <1.0 — cluster-gap cuts in the measured θp "
                    "landscape (2026-09-04); 95% CI in parentheses; "
                    "(ceiling) = family exceeded the bank span — "
                    "extrapolated, the bank cannot discriminate there'>"
                    f"θp {_tv:.2f}{_ci}"
                    + (" (ceiling)" if _tp_ceil else "") + "</span>")
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        if pct is not None:
            qbits.append(
                f"<span style='color:{_elem_color(round(pct), 100)}' "
                "title='fixed-battery share coloring: green >13/15 · "
                "yellow 11/15–13/15 · red <11/15 (operator 2026-09-04)'"
                f">{pct:.1f}%</span>")
        if tp is None and pct is not None:
            # spec 044 FR-005 fallback label (ported from the retired
            # ranking table): no theta yet -> the row ranks by the
            # compatibility fraction, dimmed + named
            qbits.append(
                " <span class='dim' title='FALLBACK rank (compatibility "
                "fraction): no GBench θ yet (spec 044 FR-005)'>· fallback</span>")
        # sort key (operator 2026-09-03 revision): rows with an IN-BANK
        # measured thetap sort above battery-only rows, then by thetap.
        # A span-exceeded (ceiling-extrapolated) thetap NO LONGER earns
        # the 200-block — the bank cannot discriminate above its top
        # difficulty (tiel-q4's 6.19±2.7 was sorting it #1); the row
        # falls back to the battery-share 100-block while its thetap
        # stays displayed with a (ceiling) marker.
        _qsort = 100.0
        if tp is not None and not _tp_ceil:
            try:
                _qsort = 200.0 + (float(tp) + 5.0) * 10.0
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                _qsort = 200.0
        if pct is not None:
            _qsort += pct / 100.0
        q_cell = " · ".join(qbits) if qbits else "—"
        # recipe name appended to the quality cell (operator 2026-09-04):
        # the SAME value the quality-ranking table's recipe column shows
        # (pair_key / tag, e.g. 'tiel-q6') — not the model-file key
        _rk = str(a.get("pair_key") or a.get("tag") or "").strip()
        if _rk:
            q_cell += (f" <span class='dim' title='recipe name (the "
                       f"quality-ranking recipe column value)'>· {_esc(_rk)}</span>")
        ts = _tool_lookup(served)
        tool_cell = (f"<span style='color:{_tool_color(ts[1])}'>"
                     f"{ts[1]:.0f}</span>" if ts else "—")
        _b = _BENCH.get(str(key)) or _BENCH.get(
            PRP_KEY_ALIASES.get(str(key), "")) or {}
        pptg = a.get("pptg") or (None, None)
        tg = pptg[1] if pptg[1] is not None else _b.get("tg")
        pc = _b.get("pp_ctx") or {}
        sp = []
        if tg is not None:
            sp.append(f"tg <span style='color:{_speed_color('tg', tg)}'>"
                      f"{tg:.1f}</span>")
        for lbl, kk in (("@512", "512"), ("@4k", "4096"), ("@64k", "65536")):
            v = pc.get(kk)
            if v is not None:
                sp.append(f"pp{lbl} <span style='color:{_speed_color('pp', v)}'>"
                          f"{v:.0f}</span>")
        srv = server_of(tag, a.get("hw"))
        _mem = mem_of(tag, rdir)
        _mem_bit = ""
        if _mem:
            _mem_bit = (
                f"<span class='dim' title='{_esc(_mem.get('method', ''))} — "
                f"{_esc(str(_mem.get('host', '')))} "
                f"{_esc(str(_mem.get('date', '')))}, ctx 65536'>"
                f" · VRAM {_mem['vram_gtt_gib']:g} · RAM {_mem['ram_rss_gib']:g} GiB"
                "</span>")
        speed_cell = ((("<br>".join([" · ".join(sp[:2]), " · ".join(sp[2:])])
                        if len(sp) > 2 else " · ".join(sp)) if sp else "—")
                      + (f" <span class='dim'>{_esc(srv)}</span>" if srv else "")
                      + _mem_bit)
        _mt = 0
        for bat in ("fcb15", "traps"):
            try:
                _mt = max(_mt, os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(
                    rdir or "results", f"{bat}-{tag}.jsonl")))
            except OSError:
                pass
        upd_cell = (time.strftime("%y%m%d %H:%M", time.localtime(_mt))
                    if _mt else "—")  # plain: not a ranking factor
        # phase sequence in the Updated column (operator 2026-09-04,
        # revised same day): the FULL fixed sequence F T G P K W rendered
        # with state colors — green = done (tooltip = the leg's date),
        # yellow = in progress (live banner), red = not measured — so the
        # gaps jump out instead of only the wins listing
        _ph_done = {}
        for _pl, _pt in (("F", "fcb15"), ("T", "traps")):
            for _mg in a.get("merge") or []:
                if _mg.endswith("-" + _pt):
                    try:
                        # both batteries write fcb15- prefixed jsonls
                        _pmt = os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(
                            rdir or "results", f"fcb15-{_mg}.jsonl"))
                        _ph_done[_pl] = time.strftime(
                            "%y%m%d", time.localtime(_pmt))
                    except OSError:
                        pass
                    break
        for _lb, _fn in (("G", f"gbench-{_prp_pair_key(a.get('tag') or '')}.report.json"),):
            try:
                _pmt = os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(rdir or "results", _fn))
                _ph_done[_lb] = time.strftime("%y%m%d", time.localtime(_pmt))
            except OSError:
                pass
        if ((doc.get("prp") or {}).get(key) or {}).get("ppl") is not None:
            _ph_done["P"] = str(((doc.get("prp") or {}).get(key) or {}).get("date") or "")
        if ((doc.get("prp") or {}).get(key) or {}).get("kld") is not None:
            _ph_done["K"] = ""
        if ts:
            _ph_done["W"] = ""
        upd_cell += " " + _phase_seq(_ph_done, tag, doc)
        # sortable raw values (operator 2026-09-03: click-to-sort columns)
        _prp_sv = "-1"
        try:
            _t1v = ((doc.get("prp") or {}).get(key) or {}).get("top1_pct")
            if _t1v is not None:
                _prp_sv = f"{float(_t1v):.4f}"
            else:
                _rp = _prp_ref_ppl(key, doc)
                _dp = ((doc.get("prp") or {}).get(key) or {}).get("ppl")
                if _rp and _dp:
                    _prp_sv = f"{_rp / float(_dp):.6f}"
        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
            _prp_sv = "-1"
        _bat_sv = f"{sum(shares) / len(shares):.4f}" if shares else "-1"
        _q_sv = f"{_qsort:.6f}"
        _tool_sv = f"{ts[1]}" if ts else "-1"
        _tg_sv = f"{tg}" if tg is not None else "-1"
        _upd_sv = f"{_mt}" if _mt else "0"
        # popup attrs + row class migrated from the retired ranking table
        # (operator 2026-09-04): the .qr-row click-popup JS now binds here
        _tmodel = (a.get("model") or "—").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        _tmodel = _tmodel[:-5] if _tmodel.endswith(".gguf") else _tmodel
        _tqnt = (quant_of(served, "") if served else
                 quant_of(a.get("model"),
                          a.get("recipe_key") or a.get("recipe")) or "—")
        try:
            _gen_dim = " rg-old" if int(a.get("gen") or 1) < 2 else ""
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            _gen_dim = ""
        _qtxt = ((str(a.get('k', 0)) + '/' + str(a.get('n', 0)))
                 if a.get('n') else '—')
        rows.append(
            f"<tr class='qr-row{_gen_dim}' tabindex='0' "
            f"data-tag='{_esc(a['tag'])}' data-upd='{_esc(a.get('upd') or '')}' "
            f"data-recipe='{_esc(a['recipe'])}' "
            f"data-agent='{_esc(a.get('agent') or 'none')}' "
            f"data-agentsmd='{_esc(a.get('agents_md') or '')}' "
            f"data-model='{_esc(_tmodel)}' data-quant='{_esc(_tqnt)}' "
            f"data-size='{_esc(size)}' "
            f"data-battery='{_esc(a.get('battery') or battery_of(a['tag']))}' "
            f"data-server='{_esc(server_of(a['tag'], a.get('hw')))}' "
            f"data-fcb='{_esc(fc or '—')}' "
            f"data-traps='{_esc(tr or '—')}' "
            f"data-mode='{'bestof' if 'bestof' in a else 'single'}' "
            f"data-greedy='{_esc(a.get('greedy', '—'))}' "
            f"data-q='{_esc(_qtxt)}' "
            f"data-bestof='{_esc(a.get('bestof', '—'))}' "
            f"data-shots='{a.get('shots_avg', '—')}' "
            f"data-wall='{a.get('wall_s', 0):.0f}s' "
            f"data-attempts='{_esc(a.get('attempts_profile') or '—')}' "
            f"data-turns='{_esc(str(a.get('turns')) if a.get('turns') else '—')}' "
            f"data-hw='{_esc(a.get('hw') or '—')}' "
            f"data-prp='{_esc(_prp_cell(a, doc))}' "
            f"data-gbwall='{_gbw_txt(rdir, key)}'>"
            f"<td data-sv='{_esc((a.get('model') or '').rsplit('/', 1)[-1])}'>{model_cell}</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='{_prp_sv}'>{prp_cell}</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='{_bat_sv}'>{bat_cell}</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='{_q_sv}' data-qr='{_qsort:.4f}' "
            f"data-qfb='{'1' if tp is None else ''}'"
            f">{q_cell}</td>"
            f"<td style='text-align:center' data-sv='{_tool_sv}'>{tool_cell}</td>"
            f"<td style='font-size:11px' data-sv='{_tg_sv}'>{speed_cell}</td>"
            f"<td style='white-space:nowrap' data-sv='{_upd_sv}'>{upd_cell}</td>"
            "</tr>")
    # in-progress pairs (migrated from the retired ranking table):
    # dimmed, no verdict cells, never rank — but a COMPLETED leg keeps
    # its own evidence: state (banner-aware), Updated (leg mtime + phase
    # icons), Speed (tg from tokens/wall) — operator 2026-09-04
    _nr_tags = {(r.get("tag") or "") for r in
                (doc.get("now_running") or [])}
    for fcb, traps, pair in partial_pairs or []:
        arm = fcb or traps
        if arm is None:
            continue
        _pmodel = (arm.get("model") or "—").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        _pparts, _plegs = [], []
        for _a2, _sfx, _full in ((fcb, "FCB", 15), (traps, "TRAPS", 13)):
            if _a2:
                try:
                    _n2 = int((_a2.get("with_retry") or "0/0")
                               .split("/")[1])
                except (IndexError, ValueError):
                    _n2 = 0
                _pparts.append(f"{_sfx} {_n2}/{_full}")
                if _n2 == _full:
                    _plegs.append((_sfx[0], _a2))
        _mt = max((a2 or {}).get("mtime", 0) for a2 in (fcb, traps) if a2)
        age = time.time() - _mt
        _mine = ({a2.get("tag") for a2 in (fcb, traps) if a2}
                 | {pair, f"{pair}-traps", f"{pair}-fcb15"}) & _nr_tags
        if (_mine or age < 300) and age < 1800:
            _state = "in progress"
        elif age < 1800:
            _state = "queued (awaiting its turn)"
        elif str(pair).startswith("smoke-") or (traps and not fcb
                                                 and _pparts
                                                 and _pparts[0].endswith("13/13")):
            _state = "gate final (TRAPS-only)"
        else:
            _state = "incomplete (stale)" if age > 86400 else "partial"
        _upd = time.strftime("%y%m%d %H:%M", time.localtime(_mt)) if _mt else "—"
        _pdone = {k: time.strftime("%y%m%d", time.localtime(_mt))
                  for k, _a2 in _plegs}
        _upd += " " + _phase_seq(_pdone, arm.get("tag") or "", doc)
        _tg = None
        try:
            _w = float(arm.get("wall_s") or 0)
            _to = float(arm.get("tok_out") or 0)
            if _w > 0 and _to > 0:
                _tg = _to / _w
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            _tg = None
        _speed = f"{_tg:.1f} t/s" if _tg else "—"
        # operator 2026-09-04: greyed (partial-pair) rows still carry
        # their KNOWN identity — size + sha + PPL/KLD + recipe + server
        # are all determined BEFORE the first battery leg lands (pipeline
        # phase order: TRAPS first). Same registries the ranked rows use;
        # nothing here ranks (data-sv stays -1/-999).
        _psz = size_of(_pmodel)
        _psh8 = gguf_sha8(_pmodel) or _file_sha8(_pmodel) or ""
        _pmodel_cell = (_esc(_pmodel)
                        + (f" <span class='dim'>· {_esc(_psz)} · {_esc(_psh8[:8])}"
                           "</span>" if (_psz != "—" and _psh8) else ""))
        _prp_mini = _prp_cell(arm, doc)
        _psrv = server_of(pair, arm.get("hw"))
        _pmem = mem_of(pair, rdir)
        _pmem_bit = ""
        if _pmem:
            _pmem_bit = (f"<span class='dim' title='{_esc(_pmem.get('method', ''))} — "
                         f"{_esc(str(_pmem.get('host', '')))} "
                         f"{_esc(str(_pmem.get('date', '')))}, ctx 65536'>"
                         f" · VRAM {_pmem['vram_gtt_gib']:g} · RAM {_pmem['ram_rss_gib']:g} GiB"
                         "</span>")
        _speed_full = (_speed
                       + (f" <span class='dim'>{_esc(_psrv)}</span>"
                          if _psrv and _psrv != "—" else "")
                       + _pmem_bit)
        rows.append(
            f"<tr class='qr-row rg-old dim' tabindex='0' "
            f"title='partial pair — ranks only when both batteries complete' "
            f"data-tag='{_esc(arm['tag'])}' data-recipe='{_esc(pair)}' "
            f"data-wall='{arm.get('wall_s', 0):.0f}s'>"
            f"<td data-sv='-1'>{_pmodel_cell}</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='-1'>{_prp_mini}</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='-1' class='dim'>{_state} — "
            f"{' · '.join(_pparts) or 'starting'}</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='-999'><span class='dim'>{_esc(pair)}</span></td>"
            f"<td data-sv='-1'>—</td>"
            f"<td data-sv='{_tg or -1}'>{_speed_full}</td>"
            f"<td style='white-space:nowrap' data-sv='{_mt or 0}'>{_upd}</td></tr>")
    if not rows:
        return ""
    return ("<section><details id=\"ts-sec\" class=\"qr-collapse\">"
            "<summary class=\"label\" style=\"cursor:pointer;user-select:none\""
            " title=\"What this is: the one-glance scoreboard — every\n"
            "measured model with its key verdicts, sorted by quality, then\n"
            "tools, then speed. Use it to pick the winner fast; click to\n"
            "collapse (choice remembered).\">"
            "Technical summary — the one-glance who-wins scoreboard</summary>"
            "<div class=\"panel\" style=\"overflow-x:auto\"><table "
            "class='tech-summary' style='width:100%;table-layout:fixed;"
            "font-size:12px'>"
            "<colgroup>"
            "<col style='width:18%'><col style='width:11%'>"
            "<col style='width:13%'><col style='width:11%'>"
            "<col style='width:5%'><col style='width:30%'>"
            "<col style='width:12%'></colgroup>"
            "<thead><tr>"
            "<th title='The serving identity of the arm: publisher / model\n"
            "file \u00b7 GiB \u00b7 sha8 of the resolved GGUF. Greyed rows are\n"
            "partial pairs (ranks only when both batteries complete); click\n"
            "a row for the full provenance popup.'>Model</th>"
            "<th title='Logit fidelity vs the family reference master,\n"
            "PERCENTAGE-FIRST: top-1% agreement (or recovery rec vs the\n"
            "anchor for cross-model rows), colored >94 green / 90\u201394\n"
            "yellow / <90 red; raw KLD colored <0.04 / 0.04\u20130.1 / >0.1.\n"
            "Exact values (4-dec ppl + protocol) ALWAYS in the cell\n"
            "tooltips \u2014 no precision lost to the display.'>PRP+KLD (vs BF16)</th>"
            "<th title='Fixed-battery pass counts, per-element colored by\n"
            "share (green >13/15, red <11/15, else yellow \u2014 generalized\n"
            "to TR-14 and GB-30). Honest merit: items lost whole to\n"
            "token-budget truncation (every attempt finish=length, zero\n"
            "content) leave the denominator; raw stays in the tooltip.\n"
            "@n/n/n/n = solved-at-attempt profile.'>TRAPS+FCB+GBench</th>"
            "<th title='\u03b8p = GBench private_api IRT ability (95% CI;\n"
            "color: green \u22652.5 / yellow 1.0\u20132.5 / red <1.0, cluster-gap\n"
            "cuts) + the fixed-battery share (same share rule). (ceiling)\n"
            "= family exceeded the bank span. \u00b7 fallback = no \u03b8 yet, the\n"
            "row ranks by compatibility fraction (spec 044 FR-005). The\n"
            "dim suffix is the recipe name (the ranking recipe value).'>Quality</th>"
            "<th title='full88 tool battery score (0\u2013100), deterministic\n"
            "grader; colored \u226590 green / 60\u201389 yellow / <60 red.'>Tools</th>"
            "<th title='tg = generated tokens per wall second; pp = prompt\n"
            "tokens over the non-decode share \u2014 derived from battery\n"
            "token/wall telemetry, not a separate bench (tooltip says so\n"
            "per cell). Never compare across hardware classes.\n"
            "Memory (operator 2026-09-04): VRAM = GTT delta \u00b7 RAM = host\n"
            "RSS, recipe loaded @64k ctx by quick load/unload on the\n"
            "node class named in the cell; method + host + date in the\n"
            "cell tooltip. Absent memory = weights no longer on disk \u2014\n"
            "a gap, never a guess.'>Speed / Memory</th>"
            "<th title='Last artifact write across the arm\u2019s legs, then the\n"
            "FULL phase sequence: F FCB \u00b7 T TRAPS \u00b7 G GBench \u00b7 P PRP \u00b7\n"
            "K KLD \u00b7 W tools \u2014 green = done (tooltip = the leg\u2019s date),\n"
            "yellow = in progress, red = not measured.'>Updated</th>"
            "</tr></thead>"
            "<tbody>" + "".join(rows) + "</tbody></table>"
            "<style>.tech-summary th{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}"
            ".tech-summary th:hover{color:#d7dce6}</style>"
            "<script>(function(){var t=document.querySelector("
            "'table.tech-summary');if(!t)return;var ths=[].slice.call("
            "t.tHead.rows[0].cells),tb=t.tBodies[0],base=ths.map(function("
            "h){return h.textContent}),st={i:-1,d:1};"
            "function doSort(ix,dir){st.i=ix;st.d=dir;"
            "var rows=[].slice.call(tb.rows);"
            "rows.sort(function(a,b){var va=a.cells[ix].getAttribute("
            "'data-sv'),vb=b.cells[ix].getAttribute('data-sv');"
            "var na=parseFloat(va),nb=parseFloat(vb);"
            "if(!isNaN(na)&&!isNaN(nb))return(na-nb)*st.d;"
            "return String(va).localeCompare(String(vb))*st.d;});"
            "rows.forEach(function(r){tb.appendChild(r)});"
            "ths.forEach(function(x,j){x.textContent=base[j]});"
            "h.textContent=base[ix]+(st.d===1?' \u25b2':' \u25bc');"
            "try{localStorage.setItem('gefc-tech-sort',"
            "JSON.stringify({i:ix,d:st.d}))}catch(e){};}"
            "ths.forEach(function(h,ix){h.addEventListener('click',"
            "function(){var dir=(st.i===ix)?-st.d:((ix===0)?1:-1);"
            "doSort(ix,dir);});});"
            "try{var s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("
            "'gefc-tech-sort')||'null');"
            # default (operator 2026-09-03): the MULTI-COLUMN cascade
            # quality -> tools -> tg, all descending; saved user sort wins
            "function msort(){var rs=[].slice.call(tb.rows);"
            "rs.sort(function(a,b){"
            "function sv(r,i){return parseFloat(r.cells[i].getAttribute("
            "'data-sv'))||-1}"
            "var q=sv(b,3)-sv(a,3);if(q)return q;"
            "var t=sv(b,4)-sv(a,4);if(t)return t;"
            "return sv(b,5)-sv(a,5);});"
            "rs.forEach(function(r){tb.appendChild(r)});"
            "ths.forEach(function(x,j){x.textContent=base[j]});"
            "ths[3].textContent=base[3]+' \u25bc';ths[4].textContent="
            "base[4]+'\u2082';ths[5].textContent=base[5]+'\u2083';}"
            "if(s&&s.i>=0&&ths[s.i]){doSort(s.i,"
            "s.d===1?1:-1);}else{msort();}"
            "}catch(e){try{msort()}catch(x){}}})();</script>"
            + _ladder_line
            + "</div></details>"
            "<script>try{var o=localStorage.getItem('gefc-ts-open');"
            "var d=document.getElementById('ts-sec');"
            "d.open=(o==='1');"
            "d.addEventListener('toggle',function(){"
            "try{localStorage.setItem('gefc-ts-open',d.open?'1':'0')}"
            "catch(e){}});}catch(e){}</script>"
            "</section>")



def render_html(doc, out_html, rdir=None):
    e = html.escape
    cells = doc["cells"]
    values = row_axis_values(cells)

    axis_rows = []
    anchors = doc.get("anchors", {})
    for axis in ["rci", "hri", "rsi", "sfi", "cbi", "rvi", "sli", "cei"]:
        cs = sorted((c for c in cells if c["axis"] == axis), key=lambda c: c["date"], reverse=True)
        if not cs:
            axis_rows.append(
                f"<tr><td>{e(AXIS_LABELS[axis])}</td>"
                f"<td colspan='8' class='nm'>not measured</td></tr>"
            )
            continue
        for i, c in enumerate(cs):
            ci = f"[{c['ci95'][0]:.2f}, {c['ci95'][1]:.2f}]" if c.get("ci95") else "—"
            head = e(AXIS_LABELS[axis]) if i == 0 else ""
            star = " ★" if values.get(axis) is c else ""
            # FR-003: anchored % ALONGSIDE (never instead of) raw + CI;
            # unanchored cells render the explicit anchor-unavailable marker
            av = anchors_mod.render_anchor(c, anchors)
            if av is None:
                anch = ("<span class='nm'>anchor unavailable</span>"
                        if axis not in anchors_mod.EXCLUDED_AXES
                        else "raw-only (CEI excluded)")
            else:
                anch = (
                    f"<b>{av['pct']:.1f}%</b>"
                    + (" <span class='nm'>(inverted)</span>" if av["inverted"] else "")
                    + f"<br><span class='dim'>0 = {e(av['zero']['recipe'])} · "
                    f"100 = {e(av['hundred']['recipe'])}</span>"
                )
            axis_rows.append(
                f"<tr><td>{head}</td><td class='v'>{e(fmt_val(c))}{star}</td>"
                f"<td>{e(ci)}</td><td>{anch}</td><td>{e(str(c['tuple']['recipe']))}</td>"
                f"<td>{e(str(c['date']))}</td><td>{e(str(c['hardware']))}</td>"
                f"<td>{e(c['artifact'])}</td>"
                f"<td class='tup'>{e(fmt_tuple(c))}</td></tr>"
            )


    merged, partial_pairs = merge_recipe_arms(doc["arms_table"], rdir)
    _serving_json = json.dumps(SERVING_RECIPES).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    _running = doc.get("now_running") or []
    _run_strip = ""
    if _running:
        _items = " · ".join(
            f"{e(r['tag'])} ({r['leg']} leg, started {r['started']})"
            for r in _running)
        _run_strip = ("<div class='label' style='color:#2e7d32;font-size:14px'>"
                      f"▶ now running: {_items}</div>\n")
    # header tooltips (operator 2026-08-31): detailed hover help on the
    # ranking columns — native title= attribute, no JS (BATTERY_TIPS style)
    _TIP_FCBTRAPS = ("What the pair solved, in the order it ran.\n"
        "TRAPS-14 (TR): 13 short Python sharp-edge probes — first leg.\n"
        "FCB-15 (FCB): 15 coding tasks graded by hidden unit tests,\n"
        "machine-only — second leg.\n"
        "GB: GBench progress, administered/expected items of the live\n"
        "adaptive staircase (30 items at runner defaults).\n"
        "A pair ranks only when BOTH fixed batteries complete; while a\n"
